Beijing Enterprises Water Group Limited (the “Company” and, together with its subsidiaries, collectively referred to as the “Group”) upheld the operational objective of “customer orientation through innovation capability” by taking a revolutionary approach in its ongoing pursuit of operational excellence and delivery of quality products and services. With a significantly enhanced profit structure, consistently improving cash flow and a steady transformation towards an asset-light enterprise, the Group has laid a solid and sustainable foundation, which has facilitated a smooth implementation of the 14th Five-Year Plan.
With the support of the management and the departments at all levels across the Group, the Group has been focusing on its core business of water treatment and actively implementing the Yangtze River Protection. By co-operating with China Three Gorges Corporation (“CTG”), the Group has taken an active role in the new chapter of China's ecological progress.
PERFORMANCE REVIEW Review of Principal Businesses Adhering steadfastly to the development strategy of maintaining a portfolio that places equal values on light and heavy assets while keeping the expenditure within the limits of revenue, the Group managed to achieve stable growth in its annual results. For the year ended 31 December 2021, revenue was HK$27,880.1 million, which increased by 9.9% year-on-year. Total profit attributable to shareholders of the Company amounted to HK$4,195.9 million, which increased by 0.3% year-on-year. Basic earnings per share for the year was HK41.42 cents. In recognition of the continuous support of the shareholders to the Company, the board of directors of the Company (the “Board”) resolved to make a final cash dividend of HK6.7 cents per share to the shareholders.
While the pandemic continued to rage around the world in 2021, the staff of the Group has united as one in weathering such difficult times. The Group strictly complied with the pandemic-control regulations of local governments in order to ensure the health and safety of the staff, the sound operation of the water plants, the timely completion of projects and, hence, the satisfaction of the clients. Despite the immense challenges posed by the volatile development of the pandemic for the healthy development of environmental enterprises, the Group abided by the philosophy of safe development, strengthened its quality assets, stepped up risk control and secured ample cash reserves for expansion with the aims of taking a leadership role in the ecological industry and achieving mutual success and shared benefits with more business partners.
Beijing Enterprises Water Group Limited Annual Report 2021 05 CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT Water treatment services For the year ended 31 December 2021, the Group recorded a net increase in daily design capacity of 2,761,226 tons, bringing the total daily design capacity to 44,885,962 tons.
Affected by the global pandemic and the current external and internal situation, the room for market increment has shrunk. In 2021, the Group secured new contracts of water services involving a daily water volume of 3,960,221 tons, demonstrating the operation and delivery capacity and the market’s full recognition of the Group. The newly-secured Luwan River project of 700,000 tons will allow the Group to expand its urban management operation by bringing its professionalism and capability into full play and to ensure the water safety of the urban areas by entering into long-term co-operation with the local governments.
The National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development have jointly issued the 14th Five-Year Plan for Urban Sewage Treatment and Resources Utilisation Development Plan ( 《 「十四五」 城鎮污 水處理及資源化利用發展規劃》 ) for promoting sewage resource utilisation, strengthening the operation and maintenance of water facilities and unleashing greater market demand. Being customer-oriented, the Group focused on boosting the quality and efficiency of urban sewage treatment and promoting ecological sewage resource utilisation with a scientific approach with an increase in reclaimed water treatment capacity of 761,000 tons per day during the year.
The introduction of the Measures for the Management of Urban Water Supply Prices ( 《城鎮供水價格管理辦法》 ) and the Measures for the Supervision and Examination of Pricing Cost of Urban Water Supply （ 《城鎮供水定價成本監審辦法》 ） have provided useful guidance for water supply enterprises to eliminate unreasonable charges and set the tariffs at levels that can compensate for the reasonable costs incurred for water supply. By focusing on the development of new businesses including water supply, pipe network construction and sewage recycling, the Group aims to explore new areas of growth with an enriched business portfolio.
The Group has devoted full efforts to vitalising rural economy. By standardising operation and maintenance procedures and setting up intelligent operation and maintenance platforms, it has provided professional and efficient services and constantly enhanced its operating capacity. As a key initiative and an exemplary model for the construction of a world-class ecological island and the revitalisation of rural economy, the Group’s rural domestic sewage treatment project in Chongming District, Shanghai has commenced its full commercial operation during the year.
Regarding its overseas businesses, the Group has showed its agility in responding to the waves of global pandemic and taken various initiatives to ensure the steady advancement of production, operation and market expansion activities. With the aim of expanding into new business, proactive tenders have been submitted.
Beijing Enterprises Water Group Limited Annual Report 2021 06 CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT Comprehensive renovation services The Group has been fully committed to serving national strategies of protecting clear waters and lush mountains by actively participating in the Yangtze River Protection, further co-operating with CTG towards an asset-light model, enhancing its existing projects and exploring new co-operation models including “water keeper” services, thus establishing the groundwork for higher operational efficiency.
The Group is determined to achieve victory in the battle against pollution and has set up a smart industry platform covering the entire industry chain. With the launch of the smart platform for the operation management and control of the water environment along the Yuhangtang River, the smart platform for the operation and maintenance management and control of the water environment in Linyi and other projects, the Group aims to promote smart transformation and gain successful experience in the water environment sector.
Review of Other Businesses Beijing Enterprises Clean Energy Group Limited, one of the group companies, has promoted the healthy growth of the businesses of photovoltaic power generation, wind power generation and clean heat supply. With a gradual enhancement in production and operation, it will further promote the high-quality development of its new generation clean energy business.
Beijing Enterprises Urban Resources Group Limited, another group company, principally engages in the provision of environmental hygiene and hazardous waste treatment services. It has refined its business operation and carried out transformation in order to consistently improve service quality as well as customer satisfaction.
Beijing Enterprises Water Group Limited Annual Report 2021 07 CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT CORPORATE MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL Efficiently reducing pollution with the use of science and technology and supporting quality growth with a sustainable environment are among the approaches used to attain the clean water goal under the 14th Five-Year Plan. Guided by the country’s strategic planning and driven by customers’ and shareholders’ needs, the Group has persistently enhanced the standard of its corporate governance, core technologies and innovation capacity in order to cater for the people’s needs for a beautiful ecological environment.
Adhering to the strategic goals, the Group has developed a customer-centric and market-oriented organisational structure by carrying out reforms in its market investment system and regional segments. Extra efforts have been made in customer service, market development, regional penetration and co-operation so as to form a new market development system and build a reliable brand image. The service delivery team has been strengthened to boost delivery capacity and customer satisfaction. With an enhanced operational management system and a basic principle of offering customers with excellent operational services, the Group has commenced its business restructuring from investment-focused to service-based.
The Group has put in place the digital strategies, which, together with the ecological and innovative strategies, will support the transformation towards an asset-light enterprise. With the support of smart water services and the basic goal of pursuing excellence in the “1+N” digitalised operation, the construction of the internet-of-things, which is based on the BECloudTM platform for smart water services, has been upgraded and enhanced. Greater focus has been laid on technological advancement by further exploring and implementing smart control. The Group has pioneered the development of BE-EMR, the first artificial intelligence robot in the industry, the introduction of which has shown the Group’s efforts in using innovative technology for enhancing the efficiency of carbon reduction. To speed up digital transformation, the Group has also set up a smart industry platform covering the entire industry chain and established a system of digitalised competence for all business formats.
In 2021, the COVID-19 pandemic continued to take its toll around the world and the global economy was hard hit. In view of this, the Group further strengthened its cash flow management and improved its free cash flow in order to achieve higher capital efficiency. Cost management is a matter that the Group places a great deal of importance on, and the Group is the first in the industry to introduce a dynamic data and indicator library for lean management of project costs. The Group has adopted innovative ways in asset management with new industry asset management philosophy of optimised inventory with diligence and care. The BEWG Financial Shared Service Centre （北控水務財務共用服務中心） , the first of its kind in the environmental sector, was established and was nominated for CGMA Global Management Accounting 2021 China Awards – Best Shared Service Center. Moreover, the successful issuance of different types of bonds with coupon rates repeatedly reaching all-time lows has highlighted the asset value, and improved the capital structure, of the Group. This has demonstrated the good reputation of the Group in the financial market and laid a strong financial cornerstone for the Group’s quality and sustainable development.
Beijing Enterprises Water Group Limited Annual Report 2021 08 CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT In 2021, the Group has embarked on a cultural consensus project and achieved the operational objective of “customer orientation through innovation capability”. Rooted in its core values of “to be committed, to create value and to share with others”, it has defined its mission as “vitalising your life with our new water services” and vision as “becoming the world-class provider of reliable and leading water services and environmental services”. The medium-term and long-term strategic goals are to consistently acquire and manage assets in large amounts, apply technology and innovative models to new business growth, boost operational efficiency and realise corporate sustainability. With synergy across the units at all levels and co-operation between all departments, the Group strives for a consensus at the top management regarding areas from cultural identity to behavioural selfawareness, so as to foster sustainable development.
Adhering to its innovative strategies and focusing on the research and development (“R&D”) of innovative technology, the Group is dedicated to demonstrate customer orientation in its technological products. It makes use of innovative technology development model to strengthen ecological co-operation in areas of technology, expedite the accumulation of intellectual properties and strengthen the core competitiveness of its brands. By improving project-based R&D works, project commercialisation and product marketing, the Group aims to speed up the application of its technological achievements, thereby giving new impetuses to corporate transformation.
For the purpose of meeting the needs of the asset-light strategy as well as the environmental sector for high calibre and quality candidates, talent grooming is one of the Group’s priorities and the digitalisation of the human resource system has been continuously enhanced. The Group keeps motivating and exploring the potential of competent staff members who are able to meet its development requirements in order to ensure the supply of talent. Performance management is strengthened through reforms to inject fresh momentum to the organisation and give renewed vitality to employees.
In response to the country’s “3060 carbon peak and neutrality goals”, the Group takes initiatives to explore low-carbon treatment options in various aspects including policy support, understanding of vision, emission reduction techniques, new technology R&D, renewable energy operation and cross-sector collaboration, and to persistently boost the operational efficiency of its projects.
Beijing Enterprises Water Group Limited Annual Report 2021 09 CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT FUTURE PROSPECT The 14th Five-Year Plan period is crucial for the country’s ecological progress towards pollution and carbon reduction, green development and environmental improvement, which present both opportunities and challenges for the industry. As 2022 is a bridging year for carrying on with its strategic goals, the Group will earnestly implement the corporate strategies by pooling the best brains, being committed to customer orientation, undergo organisational reform, promote collaboration with integrated operations, and pursue sustainable development.
The Group will continue to acquire and manage assets in large amounts, apply technology and innovative models to new business growth, boost operational efficiency and realise corporate sustainability. To pursue the operation objective of “customer orientation through innovation capability”, it will establish a good brand image focusing on customers and innovation by strengthening customer engagement, improving customer experience and further boosting customer satisfaction. It will also vigorously acquire assets in large amounts. More efforts will be made to expand new businesses such as sludge treatment, pipe network construction, sewage recycling and urban “water keeper” services. Intrapreneurship and establishment of professional service companies are encouraged and operational efficiency will be further boosted. The human resource system will be restructured and core capabilities in capital and innovation will be built. The ultimate goal is to become a world-class provider of reliable and leading water services and environmental services.
Lastly, I would like to extend my sincere gratitude to all shareholders, customers, staff and ecological partners for their continual and tremendous support for the Group.

# The world’s biggest players – how the water sector is multiplying capital

Posted on  by [Agata Pavlinec](https://wodnesprawy.pl/en/author/agatapavlinec/)

18  
 Jan

Relentless demographic growth, climate change and decades of neglect of water management are making water rise to become the most desirable resource of the future. To meet the challenges of the global market, companies involved in its distribution, purification and treatment are consolidating and promising innovative solutions to save us from shortages. Today’s water industry has its undisputed leaders – here are the biggest of them.

## Veolia

The French Veolia group has been operating since 1853. and employs more than 220,000. people around the world. Its work focuses on optimizing the management of water, energy and raw materials in cities and industrial plants. The water sector has long been integrating with other industries, taking advantage of the synergy of comprehensive environmental solutions. Veolia’s annual revenue is currently close to [43 billion euros](https://www.veoliawatertechnologies.com/en/group-overview), and the group’s market value in January 2024. was estimated at [$22.7 billion](https://companiesmarketcap.com/veolia/marketcap/), making it the 798th most valuable company in the world.

Veolia supplies drinking water to 111 million people, in addition to operating a sewage network for 97 million, managing more than 3,500 wastewater treatment plants. Among its solutions, the company implements zero water loss (ZLD) and waste water methanation technology to produce biogas from wastewater. Ambitious plans include the construction of a wastewater treatment plant in Bangladesh’s capital that will provide 500,000 m3 water per day, and a partnership with food company Danone that will essentially reduce water consumption in factories. Veolia is also involved in the construction of a seawater desalination plant in Cornwall – its operations will cover 40 percent of the water demand in the region.

It is worth mentioning that in 2022. Veolia Group has acquired French company SUEZ, which supplies drinking water to 68 million people and generates annual revenues of [€8.8 billion](https://www.suez.com/en/about-us/group). Thus, the water industry has been further consolidated.

## Xylem

US-based Xylem was founded in 2011, but its market value is already almost [$27 billion.](https://companiesmarketcap.com/xylem/marketcap/), while revenues for 2023 are estimated at [$7.3 billion.](https://www.xylem.com/en-us/about-xylem/newsroom/press-releases/xylem-reports-third-quarter-2023-results/) The company’s activities include the construction and management of water infrastructure (including water mains and treatment plants) and specific applications in the residential, commercial and agricultural sectors. In March 2023. conglomerate has acquired Evoqua, a leader in key technology solutions related to wastewater treatment. The deal was worth [$7.5 billion](https://www.xylem.com/en-us/about-xylem/newsroom/press-releases/xylem-completes-acquisition-of-evoqua/), and the water sector gained another global player ready to face the stacked challenges.

The consolidated Xylem + Evoqua group is the world’s largest company focused exclusively on water technologies targeting utilities, industry, the commercial sector and end users. Sustainability is one of its priorities, with goals set by 2025. include, among others. realizing water savings of 16 billioncubic meters and developing solutions that positively impact the lives of at least 20 million people worldwide. In addition, the digital platform “Making Waves” offers 40 million viewers worldwide continuous access to technology news, enriching the water sector with a platform for experience sharing and expert analysis.

## Ecolab

Global water industry giants include Ecolab Inc. whose market value in January 2024 was [$56.7 billion](https://companiesmarketcap.com/ecolab/marketcap/#google_vignette). Its specialty is the development of services, technologies and systems related to water treatment, purification and hygiene. In 2023. The company achieved revenues of [$15 billion](https://www.macrotrends.net/stocks/charts/ECL/ecolab/revenue). – by 8.44 percent. larger than the previous one. Since 2011. The Ecolab Group structure also includes Nalco Water, which offers solutions for reducing water and energy consumption and improving air quality. It is also a world leader in detecting and controlling Legionella bacteria in water systems.

Ecolab’s experts have developed more than 10,000 patents over its more than 100-year history, offering innovative solutions to customers in 170 countries around the world. In addition to water services, the company’s broad portfolio includes strategies for optimizing the use of raw materials and energy and reducing the environmental impact of various activities. Ecolab’s Water for Climate program was also launched in 2022 to support private companies in meeting climate goals without compromising economic development in the coming years. In addition, Ecolab pledges to help save enough water to meet the needs of 1 billion people around the world by 2030 through ongoing projects!

## ACWA Power

The water industry is increasingly eager to get involved in seawater desalination projects, which in many areas of the world could prove crucial to solving expected deficits. UAE-based ACWA Power is a company with a market value estimated at 168 billion Saudi rials (about $45 billion) and steadily growing revenues – after the first nine months of 2023. They amounted to more than [4 billion rials](https://www.argaam.com/en/financial-reports/company-report/4269/2023/72) (about $1.1 billion). The company has desalination facilities in 12 countries in the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia.

ACWA Power is currently involved in a project to build the [world’s largest seawater desalination plant in Dubai](https://wodnesprawy.pl/en/seawater-desalination-a-giant-project-in-the-united-arab-emirates/). The investment is expected to be completed by 2026. and will use renewable energy from giant solar farms owned by the company.

## Bejing Enterprises Water Group Limited (BEWG)

The global water industry, of course, also includes companies that specialize in serving the Asian market. The largest of these is Beijing Enterprises Water Group, with a market value of [$20.5 billion](https://www.wsj.com/market-data/quotes/hk/xhkg/371) and annual revenues of [$1.7 billion](https://doc.irasia.com/listco/hk/behl/interim/2023/intpress.pdf). According to Global Water Intelligence, the BEWG group in 2019. supplied water to more than [78 million people](https://www.spml.co.in/download/media/2019-2020/global-water-intelligence-august-2019-03132.pdf), while being the largest investor in China’s water sector.

BEWG owns hundreds of water and wastewater treatment plants not only in China, but also in Malaysia and Portugal, processing daily [tens of millions](https://www.bewg.net/en/tzzgx/gszl/) tons of water. In the coming years, with the support of the China Three Gorges Corp. corporation, the company will take part in the development of infrastructure in the Yangtze River region, which is facing overcrowding, pollution and flooding.

## Water sector in the 21st century: dynamic development, huge investments

There are, of course, many more companies with global reach and billions of dollars in turnover in the water industry. In the US, American Water Works, which serves 14 million citizens in 14 states, leads the way with a market value of [$25.7 billion](https://companiesmarketcap.com/american-water-works/marketcap/). The water segment, spun off from the famous DuPont company, is also growing very rapidly, with a 2022 achieved revenues of [$6 billion](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1293221/dupont-water-and-protection-segment-revenue/). DuPont Water Solutions offers some of the most innovative water treatment and separation systems.

In the European market, the water industry also has its giants, generating admirable profits. Thames Water is the largest private water supplier and wastewater consumer in the UK, serving more than 16 million citizens. In March 2022. The company recorded annual revenues of [2.2 billion British pounds](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1393834/revenue-thames-water/).

Finally, it is also worth introducing readers to the fourth largest water company in Europe – Spain’s Aqualia, honored as Water Company of the Year 2023 by the Global Water Awards. A decisive 51 percent. shares in the company are held by the FCC’s civil services group, and the rest is owned by Australian investors. Aqualia supplies water to [43.7 million customers in 18 countries around the world](https://www.aqualia.com/web/aqualia-en/conoce-aqualia/quienes-somos), including outside Europe, and additionally handles water treatment and purification. It was singled out for its innovative technological, economic and environmental approach, as well as its close cooperation with the EU on green loan funds and its impressive and consistently implemented sustainability plan.

# 北控水务多项科技成果亮相北控集团2025年科技大会

2025-12-12 14:47:52  来源：新华网

12月8日，北控集团召开2025年科技大会暨科技创新成果奖励大会，会议传达了党的二十届四中全会精神、北京市十三届七次全会及科技奖励大会精神，强调统一思想、凝聚共识，以科技创新为集团高质量发展积蓄强大动力。北控水务集团首席顾问科学家王凯军，副总裁刘伟岩、冒建华及多名科技工作者代表出席会议。

**多项科技创新成果集中亮相**

北控水务集中展示了集团战略业务布局及重要科技创新成果，产品矩阵丰富多元。

实体设备方面，涵盖“智慧数瞳”监测设备、“BEHAO”重质筛分装置、装配式蜂巢、速粒罐、“北水小鱼”仿真实训设备等；数字化平台层面，“云涟网”、“忠虫网”等技术产品同步亮相；同时呈现由北控城市环境服务集团打造的“智慧城市大管家运行管理服务平台”，展现了城市服务领域的智能化升级成果，引发参会者广泛关注。

**王凯军、刘伟岩、冒建华**

**入选北控集团第一届科学技术委员会**

作为北控集团科技委的重要组成与支撑，科学技术委员会集合科技、产业、战略、财务等高层次人才，服务集团科技创新与产业发展实践。

北控水务王凯军、刘伟岩、冒建华入选第一届科学技术委员会。本次入选将推动北控水务更深度地参与北控集团层面的科技创新规划、产业技术攻关与战略决策研讨，对北控水务深化科技创新、链接产业资源、赋能高质量发展具有重要战略意义。

**北水科技项目荣获专项资金支持**

北水科技《高效利用内碳源脱氮除磷关键技术研究与应用示范》项目荣获北控集团科技创新专项资金支持。

该项目针对低碳氮比污水处理中普遍存在的效率低、成本高痛点，深入研究短程硝化等先进技术及微生物代谢机制，成功开发出可高效利用污泥内碳源的深度脱氮除磷新工艺，应用可大幅降低处理成本与能耗、药耗，减少占地及污泥产量，实现经济效益与环保价值的双重提升，助力提升行业提质增效，工程产业化前景广阔。

**多个项目荣获科技创新成果奖**

北控水务《再生水厂全流程智能控制技术研究》、北水科技《餐厨沼液等高氨氮废水厌氧氨氧化低碳脱氮关键技术及工程应用》项目荣获北控集团科技创新成果奖三等奖，北水科技《弱电介导强化水环境生态修复技术应用》项目荣获特别嘉奖。

上述项目分别在再生水厂智能控制、高氨氮废水处理、水环境生态修复领域取得了突破，为水务行业绿色低碳发展、提质增效提供有力技术支撑，兼具显著经济、环保效益与行业引领价值。

作为科技型企业代表，冒建华重点阐述了北控水务及北水科技的科技创新与产业发展路径。他提出，要以机制革新推动创新主体升级，联动科研、工程与产品团队实现成果转化；构建“技术+市场”双驱创新生态，借专业公司群推动技术产业化。冒建华重点介绍了“北水OS”、智能机器人、仿真实训设备及“虾工厂”等创新成果，他强调，北控水务将持续以科技创新赋能水务行业智改绿转，为大环保绿色产业化提供企业范本，彰显行业领军者的责任与担当。

未来，北控水务将以此次科技大会为契机，持续深化科技创新战略，进一步加大在水务智能化、绿色低碳处理等领域的研发投入，推动更多核心技术实现突破与产业化应用。同时，将继续完善加强与产业链上下游伙伴的协同合作，加速科技成果转化落地，以更优质的技术产品与服务，为国家生态文明建设与“双碳”目标实现贡献更多北水力量。

# BEAOA与北控速粒：北控水务首批技术产品正式面世 2022-04-28

![](https://www.bewg.net/uploadfile/2022/0428/20220428115122647.jpg) ![](https://www.bewg.net/uploadfile/2022/0428/20220428115123990.jpg) ![](https://www.bewg.net/uploadfile/2022/0428/20220428115126354.jpg) ![](https://www.bewg.net/uploadfile/2022/0428/20220428115318482.jpg)

4月27日上午，北控水务集团在京召开“创新求是，突破引领”技术发布会，首次公开发布BEAOA与北控速粒两项技术产品。发布会系统阐述集团科技创新发展战略，全面展示BEAOA及北控速粒创新技术成果并举行揭牌仪式。   
   
 **BEAOA与北控速粒技术产品正式发布**  
    
 “十四五”时期，我国生态文明建设进入以降碳为重点战略方向、推动减污降碳协同增效、促进经济社会发展全面绿色转型、实现生态环境质量改善由量变到质变的关键时期。国家一直在强化企业创新主体地位，持续推进关键核心技术攻关，深化产学研用结合。污水处理作为污染物进入水生态环境的最后一道屏障，对实现生态系统良性循环具有重要意义。  
    
 北控水务集团作为一家专注于水资源循环利用和水生态环境保护事业的旗舰企业，积极应对高标准高质量发展挑战，将创新作为企业发展的重要战略之一，持续推动技术创新攻关，不断探索产学研转化路径。本次发布的BEAOA和北控速粒技术产品即是北控水务集团创新战略的长期实践成果。  
      
 **聚焦减污降碳 BEAOA成低碳科技成果转化亮点**  
    
 近年来，我国以建设高质量城镇污水处理体系为主题，不断推动城镇污水处理及资源化利用，对高效低耗的污水处理技术需求日益增长。BEAOA是北控水务与中国工程院彭永臻院士合作研发的高效深度脱氮除磷新型处理工艺，成为污水处理过程中的减污降碳利器。  
    
 在发布会上，彭永臻院士围绕AOA新技术研发及校企联合技术转化成果进行重点介绍。为解决限制城市污水处理发展关键瓶颈问题，彭永臻院士团队自2012年率先发现后置内源反硝化现象，于2018年首次公开污泥双回流-AOA技术，在国际脱氮除磷技术领域作出突出贡献。同时，彭院士团队积极探索产学研用创新合作模式，推动科技成果转化，与北控水务联合开展AOA、短程反硝化、厌氧氨氧化等多项新技术应用试验，技术水平在国内外均处于领先地位。  
    
 北控水务2017年即开始技术布局，2018年成立技术工作组并设立专项科研攻关项目（自主立项），快速推动大规模中试研究。基于彭永臻院士提出的AOA技术理念，北控水务与彭院士深入合作，将基础研究与工程应用相互融合、共同促进，在国内外率先成功开展百吨中试和万吨级原位改造工程应用实践，使AOA技术完成从基础研究走向工程应用的蜕变，并成功打造BEAOA技术产品。  
    
 北控水务研究院常务副院长薛晓飞对BEAOA技术产品优势、应用场景、用户价值进行全面解读。第一，出水水质好，其总出水主要水质指标可达到国家地表水准Ⅲ、准Ⅳ类标准，总氮去除效率在85%以上，且耐受低温和低碳氮比污水，是一种高标准达标的优质工艺；第二，节能降耗，运行过程中节省曝气能耗25%以上，生物除磷效率可达90%（中试实验数据），大幅降低除磷药剂投加量（40%-100%），适应低碳氮比水质脱氮要求，实现零碳源投加，系统节约能源物耗的同时实现污泥原位减量30%，系统地降低污水处理厂碳排放，是行业乃至社会可持续发展的优质选择；第三，实用性强，该技术适合水厂原位改造且非常易于与各类工艺耦合，具备节省占地、方便快捷、应用广阔等特点，易于在行业内推广。  
    
 目前，在技术研发团队的共同努力下，已形成BEAOA技术工艺包和装备产品，在北京、山东、海南、广西等多个项目得以应用，未来还将为设计院、企业、政府等客户提供高效低耗低碳绿色的污水处理创新解决方案和产品。  
    
 **锚定我国污水水质特点 北控速粒创新生物处理工艺**  
     
 北控速粒技术是北控水务根据中国的低碳氮比污水水质特点，基于好氧颗粒污泥技术自主研发打造的新技术产品。北控速粒研发团队负责人张丽丽详细介绍北控速粒技术工程化研究与转化应用。  
    
 北控速粒科技攻关项目自2018年立项以来，在张丽丽的带领与指导下，经过研究团队持续攻关，千吨级生产验证项目圆满建成，并实现700多天连续稳定运行记录，成功打造国内首个基于好氧颗粒污泥技术处理市政污水的装配式产品。  
    
 在此期间，张丽丽团队实现“原碳分配调控技术”、“污泥速沉调控技术”等4项核心技术突破，成功研发速粒分配器、速粒筛选器和速粒反应强化器等硬件装备，打造速粒数据库、速粒软件系统和速粒运行平台的控制系统。北控速粒技术产品具备卓越的污泥沉降性能，在实现污水化学需氧量、氨氮、总氮、总磷高标准去除的同时，能耗可降低20%以上，项目占地可缩减50%，建设周期可缩减2/3，投资节省20%以上。  
    
 因具有紧凑性、低碳性和智能性的核心优势，北控速粒技术完美适配装配式理念，为污水处理厂提供“选择简单、建设快捷、运营简易”的全流程、完整解决方案。目前，北控速粒装配式产品主要适配2万吨/日处理规模以内的污水处理项目，可在分散式污水、中小规模城镇污水、工业点源污水和重点区域村镇污水等场景快速应用。

This webpage is from Beijing Enterprises Water Group (BEWG / 北控水务), a flagship company under Beijing Enterprises Group focused on water resource recycling and water ecological environment protection. Key company facts: BEWG ranks 157th among China's Top 500 Enterprises, is the largest urban investment, construction and operations service provider in China, and ranks first domestically in total assets, total revenue, and water treatment scale within the water industry. The company is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code: 371) and is included in the Hang Seng China-Affiliated Corporations Index and MSCI international indices.

The main news article (dated April 28, 2022) reports on BEWG's technology launch event held on April 27, 2022 in Beijing, titled "Innovation for Truth, Breakthrough for Leadership," which publicly released two technology products for the first time: BEAOA and 北控速粒 (BEWG Speed Granule).

**BEAOA Technology:**
- Developed in collaboration with Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Peng Yongzhen (彭永臻)
- A new high-efficiency deep nitrogen and phosphorus removal treatment process, serving as a tool for pollution reduction and carbon reduction in wastewater treatment
- Peng's team discovered post-anoxic denitrification in 2012 and first publicly presented sludge dual-reflux AOA technology in 2018
- BEWG began technical layout in 2017, established a technical working group in 2018, and successfully carried out 100-ton pilot testing and 10,000-ton in-situ renovation engineering applications - among the first globally
- Key advantages: effluent water quality can meet national surface water quasi-Class III and quasi-Class IV standards; total nitrogen removal efficiency above 85%; saves 25%+ aeration energy; biological phosphorus removal efficiency up to 90% (pilot data); reduces phosphorus removal chemical dosing by 40%-100%; zero carbon source dosing; 30% in-situ sludge reduction
- Already applied in Beijing, Shandong, Hainan, Guangxi projects

**BEWG Speed Granule (北控速粒) Technology:**
- Independently developed based on aerobic granular sludge technology, tailored to China's low carbon-to-nitrogen ratio wastewater characteristics
- Project initiated in 2018, led by Zhang Lili (张丽丽); completed 1,000-ton production verification with over 700 days of continuous stable operation
- China's first prefabricated/assembled product based on aerobic granular sludge technology for municipal wastewater treatment
- Achieved 4 core technology breakthroughs including "raw carbon distribution regulation" and "sludge rapid settling regulation"
- Key performance: COD, ammonia nitrogen, total nitrogen, total phosphorus high-standard removal; 20%+ energy reduction; 50% reduction in project footprint; construction period shortened by 2/3; 20%+ investment savings
- Primarily suited for projects within 20,000 tons/day capacity; applicable in decentralized sewage, small/medium municipal sewage, industrial point source sewage, and village sewage scenarios

Additional context: BEWG Vice President Mao Jianhua stated the products have completed their first step of technology commercialization and will continue toward replicable, large-scale standardized products. As of the article date, BEWG holds 772 patents, 420 software copyrights, and 10 provincial/ministerial-level science and technology awards.

# 北控水务携多项科技创新成果亮相2026中关村论坛年会 2026-03-30

![](https://www.bewg.net/uploadfile/2026/0409/20260409101912141.jpg) ![](https://www.bewg.net/uploadfile/2026/0409/20260409101934424.jpg) ![](https://www.bewg.net/uploadfile/2026/0409/20260409101934792.jpg) ![](https://www.bewg.net/uploadfile/2026/0409/20260409101934328.jpg)

3月25日至29日，以“科技创新与产业创新深度融合”为主题的2026年中关村论坛在北京举办。3月28日，北控集团旗下北控水务集团携多项科技创新成果及城市水管理方案亮相中关村论坛北控集团专场活动“科技赋能城市可持续发展大会”，聚焦“服务城市发展 创造美好生活”，通过成果发布、场景展示、专题演讲等形式，与社会各界共议水务行业数智化转型的“北控方案”。

在大会上，北控水务集团发布企业重大科技创新成果——“智慧与科技双轮驱动－城市水管理新范式”，创新打造城域级一体化协同与云链端融合的水务管理新模式，重磅推出四款核心数智化产品：污水运营管理系统（SED）、污水行业垂类大模型“Enki”、厂网协同运营管理平台和产业互联平台-云涟网，构建起“底座支撑－智慧升级－横向延伸－能力输出”的完整数智化体系，核心产品已经在北控水务内部全面验证，有效推动了运营提质增效，相关技术与平台正加快向行业推广。据北控水务集团副总裁贾丕星介绍，北控水务在“十四五”时期洞察到存量时代下数智化是行业转型的必备条件，以五年磨一剑的技术积淀，完成了从自身数字化转型到行业数智化能力输出的跨越，北控水务在数智化转型中秉承两大理念：一是以“云链端”范式实现技术、商业范式与管理模式三重升级，二是追求行业水厂从“单好”向“均好”发展，推动整个水务行业的协同升级。

贾丕星表示，基于“物在线、人在线、管理在线”的运营理念，北控水务打造的污水运营数字化底座平台，已实现水厂设备仪器数据的实时感知、运维工艺的流程化数字化、技术与经济指标的线上化管控。其深耕多年的星级运营质量管理体系，通过持续提升星级基线带动厂侧技术与管理优化，沉淀的高质量数据成为水务智能化的坚实基础。以此为依托，北控水务2025年启动研发污水领域垂类大模型“Enki”，打造“懂工艺、善决策”的污水运营智慧大脑：通过构建水务行业高质量数据集、固化专家调控经验的运营知识图谱，以小模型构建智能体，大模型统筹计算寻找全厂运行最优解训练逻辑，实现污水厂的自适应调控，目前模型正持续迭代训练，智能化水平不断提升。

“水务行业的痛点难点集中在厂网协同不足、运营效率不均、风险预警滞后、城域水体管控复杂等方面。”贾丕星强调，北控水务的厂网协同运营管理平台，打破了传统单厂模式的局限，通过“厂+管网”数据互通与AI联调联动，实现防洪排涝、溢流污染防控、减污降碳等场景的精准治理，全面提升水务系统韧性，支撑“十五五”期间城市更新改造及存量提质增效。

依托于污水运营管理系统、厂网一体化调度系统基石，北控水务推出了“云涟网”，作为产业互联网平台，打造“数据沙箱”与“模型实验室”等工具，对外提供可控数据空间服务，全面开放数据资源，将水务资产转化为数据资产。北控水务期望联合产学研推动行业智能化水平提升，加速新技术、新产品研发和迭代验证，赋能水务产业高质量发展。

城市的水系是城市的“静脉”，污水治理是守护绿水青山的关键命题。北控水务在中关村论坛的成果发布与深度分享，不仅展现了企业在水务科技领域的深厚积淀，更让行业看到数智化重构水务产业逻辑的无限可能。作为水务行业数智化转型标杆，“十五五”期间，北控水务将继续以数智化为核心能力，以运营能力代差化为目标，协同产业同仁，持续推动城市环境治理精细化、智能化发展，为美丽中国建设与城市可持续发展贡献北控力量。

The company is described as China's largest city investment, construction, and operation services provider, ranking 157th in China's Top 500 Enterprises, and holding the No.1 position in the domestic water industry in terms of total assets, total revenue, and water treatment scale. Beijing Enterprises Water Group (stock code: 371) is listed on the Hong Kong Main Board and is included in the Hang Seng China-Affiliated Corporations Index and MSCI indices.

The website's main news article reports on the company's participation in the 2026 Zhongguancun Forum held in Beijing from March 25-29, themed "Deep Integration of Technological Innovation and Industrial Innovation." On March 28, at the "Technology Empowering Sustainable Urban Development Conference" special session, Beijing Enterprises Water Group unveiled its major innovation — "Smart & Tech Dual-Driven: New Paradigm for Urban Water Management." The company launched four core digital-intelligent products: the Sewage Operation Management System (SED), the wastewater industry vertical large model "Enki," a plant-network collaborative operation management platform, and the industrial internet platform "Yunlian Wang" (Cloud Link Network), building a complete digital-intelligence system spanning "base support – smart upgrade – horizontal expansion – capability output."

The digital operations platform has achieved real-time sensing of equipment data, digitalized operational processes, and online management of technical/economic indicators. The "Enki" large model, launched in 2025, creates an "operations smart brain" that understands processes and makes optimal decisions, using high-quality industry datasets and expert knowledge graphs to enable adaptive control of sewage plants. The plant-network collaborative platform addresses industry pain points including insufficient plant-network coordination, uneven operational efficiency, lagging risk warnings, and complex urban water body management, supporting flood control, overflow pollution prevention, and carbon reduction during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period. The "Yunlian Wang" platform provides controlled data space services and data sandbox/model laboratory tools, transforming water assets into data assets.

# 北控、光大、碧水源等水务领军企业轻资产化布局加速！原因是啥？

北控、光大、碧水源等水务领军企业轻资产化布局加速！原因是啥？

2024年03月25日 10:27 北极星电力网

[新浪财经APP](https://finance.sina.com.cn/mobile/comfinanceweb.shtml?source=cjzhengwen04 "语音播报") [缩小字体](javascript:; "缩小字体") [放大字体](javascript:; "放大字体") [收藏](javascript:; "收藏本页") [微博](javascript:; "分享到微博") [微信](javascript:; "分享到微信") [分享](javascript:; "更多分享")

近日，北控水务集团轻资产科技平台公司——北水未来科技公司（简称“北水科技”）、北水云服公司（简称“北水云服”）在京揭牌成立。

近年来，水务企业在轻资产业务方面的加速布局日益受到重视，多家公司也已在这一领域取得了显著的进展。

北控水务

北控水务是近年来在轻资产业务方面积极布局并取得显著成果的企业之一。为了推动战略转型，北控水务集团成立了轻资产科技平台公司，通过培育和发展新质生产力，为集团的高质量发展积蓄新动能。该公司通过轻资产模式，在污水处理、水资源管理等领域提供技术和服务，有效降低了资本投入，提高了运营效率。目前，北控水务的轻资产转型已经迈上了新的台阶，为行业的可持续发展树立了典范。

光大水务

今年年初，光大水务宣布公司在境内外市场落实多项轻资产业务，成功对外输出工业废水治理方面的技术与经验，针对「工业+泛水」等领域探索布局取得良好进展。近年来，光大水务从业务模式、业务领域、业务协同等角度持续推动轻重资产业务平衡发展，在巩固传统业务阵地与优势的基础上，继续加大轻资产业务的拓展力度。2023年上半年，光大水务落实的轻资产业务涉及合同金额超过人民币10亿元，是2022年全年轻资产业务合同总额的近2倍，公司的轻重资产配比进一步优化。

北京排水集团

近日，北京排水集团所属北排产业集团与安徽省肥西县签署合作协议。双方将发挥各自资源禀赋，通过在污水及排水系统运行管理、智慧水务建设、城市水环境保护等领域开展全方位合作，助力当地生态文明建设再上新台阶。此项目是北京排水集团坚定落实市委市政府投资政策，市场开发业务实施轻资产转型战略的重大突破。北京排水集团通过人才、技术及管理输出，将服务首都的“厂网河一体化”成功运营经验再一次复制到安徽区域，积极为长江流域大保护贡献“北排”力量。

2020年，[碧水源](https://finance.sina.com.cn/realstock/company/sz300070/nc.shtml)发布公告，公司与中交在项目开展和内部管理上进行积极合作，将重点推进水处理提标、污水资源化等业务，专注于膜技术领域，缩减重资产规模，逐渐回归轻资产模式。

中环水务

中环水务积极服务国家重大战略，在原有传统业务基础上，积极探索高浓度工业废水处理及产业园环保管理业务、轻资产模式、直饮水等新的业务单元。

从2019年开始，[节能国祯](https://finance.sina.com.cn/realstock/company/sz300388/nc.shtml)开始调整发展战略，再次将技术创新提到公司战略的重要高度。强调用技术创新打造核心竞争力，逐步提升轻资产运营业务占比，实现了从重资产传统运营型向轻资产平台服务型企业转型。

[首创环保](https://finance.sina.com.cn/realstock/company/sh600008/nc.shtml)集团

进入“十四五”以来，首创环保集团开启了“轻重并举”的发展之路，努力由传统的投资驱动向能力驱动转型。首创环保集团依托多年来在运营、产品研发等方面的深厚积淀，积极拓展修复、环卫、大气、智慧环保等新业务，并开展委托运营、工程、咨询、EPC+O等轻资产模式实践。年初至今，首创环保集团已斩获各类轻资产项目超30个，轻资产业务贡献占总营收比例创历史新高。

四川省生态环保集团

四川省生态环保集团旗下川环公司陆续签订青神县污水处理厂二期可研、丹巴县生活垃圾处置实施方案、西昌钒钛园区三年行动规划、[中国联通](https://finance.sina.com.cn/realstock/company/sh600050/nc.shtml)数据中心节能评估、安州区饮用水源保护区划分等一批优质项目，合同金额超120万元，为实质构建轻资产项目“技术+产品+服务+工程实施”的发展模式，实现“咨询带动工程、工程反哺咨询”的年度目标打下了基础，顺利实现一季度“开门红”。

北极星水处理网认为，水务企业近年来加速布局轻资产业务，主要有以下几点原因：

首先，轻资产业务有助于公司提高盈利能力。与重资产业务相比，轻资产业务通常具有更高的服务类收入净利率。通过增加与轻资产相关的服务类收入的比例，水务企业能够更有效地利用资源，减少资本投入，从而提升企业的盈利能力。

其次，轻资产业务有助于公司降低风险和成本。传统的重资产业务往往需要大量的资金投入，涉及到建设、运营和维护等多个环节，风险相对较高。而轻资产业务则更多地依赖于技术、管理和服务等方面的能力，降低了对物质资产的依赖，从而降低了企业的运营风险和成本。

此外，随着国家对环保和可持续发展要求的提高，水务行业面临着越来越大的市场机遇。水务企业通过发展轻资产业务，可以更快地响应市场需求，拓展业务领域，提升市场竞争力。同时，轻资产业务也更符合绿色、低碳、循环的经济发展理念，有助于公司实现可持续发展。

最后，轻资产业务也有助于水务企业提高运营效率和管理水平。通过引入先进的技术和管理手段，优化业务流程，提高服务质量，公司可以更好地满足客户需求，提升客户满意度，从而进一步增强企业的市场竞争力。

综上所述，水务行业轻资产业务的布局与发展已成为行业发展的重要趋势。对于水务公司而言，通过轻资产化可以降低成本、提高效率、增强市场竞争力。未来，随着技术的不断进步和市场需求的不断变化，水务行业的轻资产业务将展现出更加广阔的发展前景。

北极星水处理网认为，水务公司应积极探索适合自身的轻资产模式，为行业的可持续发展贡献力量。

args.summary:
This is a Sina Finance news article (dated March 25, 2024, originally from 北极星电力网/北极星水处理网) reporting on the accelerating asset-light (轻资产) transformation trend among leading Chinese water utilities companies. The article details how major water companies are shifting from heavy capital-intensive models toward asset-light models to improve profitability, reduce risk, and enhance competitiveness.

Key company developments covered:
- **北控水务 (Beijing Enterprises Water Group)**: Established two light-asset technology platform companies—北水未来科技公司 (Beishui Future Technology) and 北水云服公司 (Beishui Cloud Services)—in Beijing, focused on wastewater treatment and water resource management through technology and services.
- **光大水务 (Everbright Water)**: Secured multiple light-asset projects in domestic and overseas markets, especially in industrial wastewater treatment and "industrial + pan-water" fields. In H1 2023, its light-asset contracts exceeded RMB 1 billion, nearly double the full-year total of 2022, further optimizing its heavy/light asset ratio.
- **北京排水集团 (Beijing Drainage Group)**: Signed a cooperation agreement with Feixi County, Anhui Province, covering sewage system operation, smart water construction, and urban water environment protection. This represents a major breakthrough in its light-asset transformation by exporting talent, technology, and management.
- **碧水源 (OriginWater, SZ:300070)**: Announced in 2020 cooperation with China Communications Construction (中交), focusing on membrane technology while scaling back heavy assets and returning to a light-asset model.
- **中环水务 (Zhonghuan Water)**: Exploring high-concentration industrial wastewater treatment, industrial park environmental management, and direct drinking water as new light-asset business units.
- **节能国祯 (SZ:300388)**: Since 2019, has shifted strategy to emphasize technological innovation and increase light-asset operating business share, transforming from heavy-asset operations to light-asset platform services.
- **首创环保集团 (Capital Eco-Protection, SH:600008)**: Since the "14th Five-Year Plan," adopted a "heavy and light assets in parallel" strategy, winning over 30 light-asset projects this year with light-asset revenue contributing a record-high share of total revenue.
- **四川省生态环保集团 (Sichuan Eco-Environmental Protection Group)**: Its subsidiary signed multiple consulting and planning projects (wastewater plant feasibility studies, waste disposal plans, energy assessments) totaling over RMB 1.2 million in contracts, establishing a "technology + product + service + engineering implementation" model.

The article identifies four main reasons for the light-asset trend: (1) higher net profit margins on service income, (2) reduced risk and capital costs compared to heavy infrastructure projects, (3) faster response to market opportunities amid rising environmental protection requirements and alignment with green/low-carbon/sustainable development concepts, and (4) improved operational efficiency and management through advanced technology.

首创环保集团自2017年起以年度报告范式定期发布《社会责任报告》，2021年度起发布《环境、社会  与治理（ESG）暨社会责任报告》，2024年度起发布《可持续发展报告》。报告边界  本报告覆盖首创环保集团公司所有业务，内容涉及下属各级全资、控股及参股公司，与年度报告口径保  持一致。  货币  如无特别说明，本报告所示金额均以人民币列示。  指代说明  为方便表述和阅读，本报告使用 北京首创生态环保集团股份有限公司（简称“首创环保集团”）成立于1999年，是北京市国资委所属环保旗舰上市公司（股票代码：600008.SH）。公司深耕环保行业二十余载，在城市环境、市政公用、企业环保节能等领域为客户提供高效、智慧、绿色的“水、固、气、能”综合解决方案。  企业概况  愿景值得信赖的环境可持续发展引领者使命共建清洁、美丽、繁荣的幸福家园  业务布局  首创环保集团始终致力于美丽中国建设，坚定守护生态环境，在气候变化应对中持续探索碳减排与资源循环路径。公司积极拓展AI智慧运营、厂网一体化、“水务+”“焚烧+”等新兴赛道，以技术与管理创新驱动业务系统化、多样化、价值化、双碳化转型。通过强化业务协同、提升运营效率，为客户提供更加优质、全面的环境综合服务，持续推动绿色低碳高质量发展。截至2025年末，公司在全国29个省（自治区、直辖市）、超过190个城市拥有项目，水处理能力达到2,728万吨/日，年生活垃圾处理能力1,498万吨。 首创环保集团已系统性地评估气候变化相关风险与机遇对公司财务状况、经营成果及现金流的潜在影响。2025年，公司在应对气候变化和推进低碳转型方面投入1.45亿元人民币。短期而言，此类投入可能带来运营成本的增加，但通过优化资源配置与提升运营效率，公司能够有效控制成本增幅。从中期而言，随着低碳技术的广泛应用与能源结构转型的深入推进，运营效率有望得到显著提升，从而带动经营成果改善。长期而言，坚定的低碳转型战略将有助于巩固和提升公司的市场竞争力，优化财务表现，最终为股东创造持续增长的价值。  为系统化应对气候变化带来的挑战，首创环保集团已将气候相关风险全面纳入集团整体风险管理框架，建立起涵盖风险“识别-评估-分析-应对”的闭环管理流程。公司依据《全面风险管理办法》，将气候因素深度融入现有风控体系，构建气候风险管理“三道防线”机制，确保气候风险管理的分层防控与高效协同。  首创环保集团已系统建立气候风险应急管理流程，依据《生产安全事故应急预案》﹐将气象灾害、洪水灾害、地震地质灾害纳入风险分级管控清单，并构建详细的风险矩阵，通过定期发布的《生产安全事故风险评估报告》实现风险的动态识别与精准管控。  影响、风险和机遇管理  气候风险管理“三道防线”  气候风险应急管理流程  得到控制  失去控制  事态升级  达到本级预警条件  达到本级响应条件  信息处置研判事态发展 首创环保集团依托自身在低碳技术应用、碳资产开发等领域积累的丰富实践经验，一方面将成熟的内部碳管理能力转化为对外咨询服务，助力工业、市政等领域客户探索碳管理路径；另一方面积极借鉴行业先进理念与外部技术资源，反哺自身运营降碳增效，内外协同将专业优势转化为推动全社会绿色低碳转型的赋能引擎。为推动公司“双碳”目标落地，首创环保集团以“试点先行+体系构建”为核心路径，在铜陵滨江供水厂、呼和浩特污水处理厂开展试点项目，深度、挖掘项目降碳潜力，全力探索科学可复制、可推广的碳减排实践方案。项目聚焦构建“诊断-规划-落地-管理”的能碳管理闭环体系，通过对试点水厂能源效率、碳排放来源及管理流程的全面摸排，精准锁定关键能耗环节与核心节能降碳潜力点，形成《低碳路径规划报告》，量化各阶段减碳目标，开展成本效益系统评估，搭建标准化能碳管理组织体系，为公司后续全面推广精细化、常态化的能碳管理奠定了坚实基础。 - Dual materiality assessment identified 20 material topics, with 8 of high financial materiality (environmental management, water resource management, pollutant emissions, innovation drive being highest impact)
- ESG ratings: 中诚信国际 AA-, 中证ESG A, Wind AAA, S&P CSA 37

**Safety, Quality & Customer Service:**
- Customer satisfaction: 96.68 points (target >92)
- Since 2022: 122 sewage project evaluations (7,001 items identified, 93% rectification rate); 30 water supply projects (2,311 items, 91% rectification)
- Safety investment: RMB 94.13 million; 128 safety inspections; 1,741 people trained
- No major environmental or water-related regulatory violations

**Employees & Social Contribution:**
- Employee training investment: RMB 619,400; 675 employees assisted with RMB 4.465 million in relief funds
- External donations and support: RMB 5.8474 million (consumption assistance 2.9538 million, donations 2.8936 million)

**Standards & Certification:**
- ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 certified; 100% of tier-1 suppliers signed integrity and social responsibility commitments
- Participated in national standard GB/T 46725-2025 (synergistic carbon reduction performance evaluation for urban sewage treatment) and multiple other national/group/local standards

**Resource Management:**
- Total energy consumption: 2.1094 million tons standard coal (intensity 1.12 tons/10k yuan revenue)
- 2025 chemical cost savings: RMB 12 million through procurement, quality control, and smart dosing systems (药管家 system cut dosing 12.20% in Hohhot; Beijing Dongba carbon source dosing reduced 14.50%)
- Sludge drying process at Hohhot project cut costs 15%
- Tongling water loss control project saved 370,000+ tons/year, selected for national replicable policy mechanism list

**Case Studies:**
- WEAM platform helped Kunming national flood drainage emergency base (decision efficiency +50%, real-time reporting 98%)
- Qianjiang waste incineration project identified 260+ safety risks, completed 195 rectifications
- Luancheng Gulun River ecological restoration PPP project built 100 mu of constructed wetlands
- Baotou sludge dewatering saved 2 million tons water/year
- Anqing PV project (8.71 MW) meets 53% of plant electricity needs
- Yongchuan (Ningxia Guyuan) sponge city project achieved 100% elimination of waterlogging zones in 134.24 km² demonstration area
args.key_excerpts:
"2025年是首创环保集团迈入高质量发展新阶段的重要一年。站在环保产业升级与绿色转型加速交织的时代节点，公司始终以生态文明建设为使命，深度融入国家绿色发展战略，依托'水、固、气、能'协同发展的产业体系，在守护生态环境的实践中不断探索产业创新与价值创造的新路径，为城市绿色发展与资源循环利用贡献力量。" — 董事长李伏京

"公司持续加强环保技术创新与业务协同，推动资源循环利用和能源效率提升。围绕水环境治理、固废资源化利用、大气污染防治与能源综合利用等核心领域，公司不断优化产业布局，推进技术升级与模式创新，助力城市生态环境改善和绿色低碳转型。" — 副董事长、党委书记张萌

"截至2025年末，公司在全国29个省（自治区、直辖市）、超过190个城市拥有项目，水处理能力达到2,728万吨/日，年生活垃圾处理能力1,498万吨。"

"2024年，CAPITAL CREATE®好氧颗粒污泥技术在浙江海宁市丁桥污水处理厂设施设备更新提升工程项目中成功实现商业应用落地，改造后的处理能力由4万吨/日提升至7万吨/日，实现了在不增加占地面积的情况下处理能力提升75%的效果，同时通过节能减排降低了运营成本。"

"到2029年，公司二氧化碳排放总量实现达峰；到2030年，可再生能源消费比重达到88%以上；到2050年，实现公司项目和业务活动对生物多样性的净积极影响和零净砍伐目标。"

首创环保发布“十五五”战略 盈利韧性与现金流质量双提升

来源：证券时报网作者：燕云2026-04-22 18:40

字号

超大

大

标准

小

点赞

分享

2026年4月21日，首创环保(600008)召开2025年度业绩说明会暨可持续发展报告会，全面回顾“十四五”发展成效，系统披露年度经营与财务表现，发布“十五五”战略蓝图。报告期内，公司经营底盘稳固、盈利韧性强劲、现金流质量跃升、科技创新提速，以运营为核、轻资产赋能、数智化驱动，持续领跑国内环保产业高质量发展赛道。

**回望“十四五” 盈利韧性行业领先**

回望“十四五”，我国环境产业加速变革，行业整体从高速扩张转向以“存量提质增效”为核心的高质量发展阶段，市场竞争格局加速重构。首创环保坚守稳健经营底色，夯实转型升级根基，稳步实现向新而行、向高提质、向深布局。“十四五”时期，剔除大额资产处置影响，公司营业收入始终保持在188亿元以上，归母净利润在2022年短期波动后迅速修复回升，实现三年连增，盈利韧性领跑行业。公司资产规模在完成资产处置后，仍能稳固保持千亿级规模，资产负债率良性下行，内生增长动能全面焕发生机。“十四五”时期，累计分红金额达45.51亿元(含2025年年度分红)，较“十三五”时期翻一番，彰显公司持续回报股东的坚定意愿与经营实力。

![image.png](https://static-web.stcn.com/upload/2026/0422/18/1776852592802993.png "1776852592802993.png")

**经营稳健提质 现金流与盈利质量双升**

2025年，公司实现营业收入188.86亿元，剔除资产处置等一次性因素后核心业务保持稳健；归母净利润17.72亿元，扣非归母净利润16.02亿元，同比增长2.68%，盈利质量持续夯实。运营类业务实现收入157.92亿元，同比增长2.57%，占总收入比重提升至83.62%，较上年大幅提升6.83个百分点，运营驱动的增长模式全面成型，抗周期能力显著增强。

现金流与财务结构持续优化，成为年度最大亮点。全年经营活动现金流净额37.62亿元，资本支出稳步压降，自由现金流达10.02亿元，为近年来首次年度转正，标志着公司从投资扩张转向内生造血的高质量阶段。公司持续优化融资结构，积极推动有息负债“存量置换+增量优化”策略，综合融资成本下降46BP，财务费用同比优化9.46%；资产负债率控制在63.76%，财务安全垫持续增厚，为长期稳健发展筑牢根基。

股东回报力度再创新高。2025年公司实施上市以来首次中期分红，全年预计现金分红8.81亿元，股利支付率将达49.71%，创近年新高。“十四五”时期预计累计分红45.51亿元，较“十三五”实现翻倍，以真金白银回馈投资者，彰显长期价值创造能力与责任担当。

**运营业务筑牢底盘 核心产能与效率稳步提升**

业务运营提质增效，核心产能稳中有进。供水总产能达1260.62万吨/日，污水处理总产能1467.39万吨/日，垃圾焚烧已投产规模22570吨/日，产能利用率维持高位。水务板块产销差率持续优化，污水结算量平稳；固废板块垃圾焚烧业务处理量771.91万吨，上网电量24.13亿千瓦时，运营效率与盈利水平同步提升。

公司以“供水+”“污水+”“焚烧+”延伸价值链，水务衍生、固废衍生、工业水处理、环保装备等高价值业务多点开花，全年新增订单规模可观，海外装备订单实现突破。运营业务持续发挥压舱石作用，为公司穿越行业周期、实现稳健增长提供坚实支撑。

**科技创新提速 技术产品化赋能产业升级**

科技创新与数智转型加速落地。2025年研发投入2.12亿元，好氧颗粒污泥技术入选国家科技重大专项，成功打造北京市原创技术策源地。公司发布AI+环保行动计划，在污水运营、设计审核、垃圾焚烧、无人环卫、大气治理、城市水环境等场景落地智能应用，以数字技术驱动全流程降本增效，推动“数字环保”向“智慧环保”升级。

依托25年千亿级环保基础设施运营经验，公司在水、固、气领域已储备资源循环、能源回收、节能低碳的核心工艺技术体系，牢牢把握转型发展机遇。“蓝色水工厂”推动污水处理向资源能源回收转型，CAPITAL CREATE®技术使浙江海宁项目生化段能耗下降54%，并实现零碳源投加；通过数理与机理模型耦合，ASMART®智控系统将项目实施周期缩短50%，技术赋能成效显著。

**AI驱动变革 数字厂长1.0重塑产业运行的基础能力**

在首创环保集团2025年度业绩说明会暨可持续发展报告发布会上，首创环保正式发布人工智能转型阶段性成果“数字厂长1.0”，系统展示公司以AI赋能水务运营、推动产业能力升级的最新进展。“数字厂长1.0”并非对传统系统的简单叠加，而是面向真实运行场景，围绕人员、数据、设备、知识和流程重构形成的新型工作系统。该产品聚焦市政供排水业务，强调以智能化增强人、服务协同运行，推动系统深度参与运行分析、异常研判、处置建议和经验沉淀，逐步构建可持续迭代的智慧运营闭环。

该项目由首创环保与清华大学联合推进，双方结合产业场景、运行经验与科研能力，共同探索产业级AI在水务领域的落地路径。首创环保未来将继续以真实业务需求为牵引，推动更多场景接入和能力沉淀，加快形成可复制、可推广、可持续进化的智慧水务运营体系，为企业高质量发展和可持续发展注入新动能。

**ESG深度融合 绿色低碳引领可持续发展**

历经5年探索，首创环保已走出可持续发展与经营战略深度融合的发展之路，可持续发展已经成为企业拓宽转型增长的重要路径。在“双碳”目标驱动下，环保行业正从“末端治污”转向“全链条服务”、从“工程建设”转向“价值创造”。

“十四五”时期，公司持续构建应对风险与机遇的发展韧性，未来可持续发展聚焦四大布局：一是运营提质增效，以千亿环保基础设施+AI赋能，加快水固气项目智慧化升级；二是技术赋能突破，以科技创新+AI推动资源能源回收转型；三是拓展衍生价值，打造“供水+、污水+、焚烧+”模式；四是推进资源整合，打破存量资产壁垒，优化资源配置。

经过5年努力，公司稳步迈向2029年碳达峰目标。“十四五”时期温室气体排放量347.97万吨，增速从最高峰的48.4%下降至2025年的3.7%。单位清洁上网电量碳排强度累计下降近14%，供水业务吨水碳排强度累计下降超13%；2025年光伏发电1722万千瓦时，净购入电力同比减少5.5%，以硬核指标彰显科技创新与智慧运营实力。

在减排方面，2025年首创环保实现温室气体减排198.6万吨，同比增长近35%，提供清洁上网电量28.18亿千瓦时、清洁热力867604吉焦、清洁燃气753万立方米，替代86.25万吨标准煤。

站在“十五五”开局新起点，首创环保锚定“市场化的行业整合者、绿色转型的引领者”核心定位，明确三大业务策略，未来将以AI科技创新与行业整合并购为双支撑，聚焦水、固、气、能协同发展，持续打造高毛利、强现金流的绿色低碳基础设施平台，致力于成为生态环境领域的领军企业，共建清洁、美丽、繁荣的幸福家园。(燕云)

未来展望 附录 在生态文明建设与“双碳”目标的双重引领下，首创环保集团以科技创新为引擎，聚焦环境维度的战略实践与技术突破，系统 推动水务行业低碳转型、 智慧生态运营与前沿技术研发的深度融合， 践行以智慧运营赋能绿色未来、 服务国家战略的长期承诺， 持续推动环保产业向绿色化、智能化、价值化方向迈进。 专题 科技驱动智慧运营 创新赋能绿色未来 公司强化产学研协同，以技术革命引领环保产业高质量发展，在水务深度降碳与资源回收、固废处理能源化利用、大气治理 与污染物监测、综合能源服务价值拓展等领域协同突破，为行业绿色低碳转型提供了可复制的实践路径。 技术革命：以创新突破打造产业新范式 “蓝色水工厂” 是首创环保集团提出的未来水工厂理念，其核心在于推动污水处理从 “末端治理” 向 “资源能源回收利用” 转变， 实现绿色低碳转型，使污水处理厂不再仅是污染物处理的终端，更成为资源与能源循环利用的起点。这一体系的构建需要技 术与运营管理双轮驱动：一方面依托核心工艺技术突破，另一方面通过运营管理智慧化提供坚实保障。 “蓝色水工厂”以公司具有自主知识产权的CAPITAL CREATE®️好氧颗粒污泥技术为核心，配合厌氧氨氧化、强化反硝化除磷、 内源反硝化等技术，搭载ASMART®️污水厂模型智控系统，通过精确曝气、智能加药等，可实现污水厂运行成本降低20%， 碳排放减少30% 左右；再结合污泥干化焚烧、热能回收系统，构建起“蓝色水工厂”资源回收、能源再生、水资源回用、碳中 和四位一体的可持续发展体系。 在运营端，以CAPRI 1 精益运营连接业务前端与能力后端，提升项目运营的整体效益，用后端的产品能力、专家能力赋能前端 的业务运营，同时将前端的数据需求、业务需求反馈给后端，持续完善能力平台，逐步探索重资产运营向轻资产运营转换。 2024 年，CAPITAL CREATE®️好氧颗粒污泥技术在浙江海宁市丁桥污水处理厂设施设备更新提升工程项目中成功实现商业应 用落地，改造后的处理能力由4 万吨/ 日提升至7 万吨/ 日，实现了在不增加占地面积的情况下处理能力提升75% 的效果， 同时通过节能减排降低了运营成本。 This is the fifth Sustainable Development Report (可持续发展报告) published by Beijing Capital Eco-Environment Protection Group Co., Ltd. (首创环保集团, stock code 600008.SH), covering the period January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2025. The report discloses the company's practices in economy, environment, society, and corporate governance.

**Company Overview**: Founded in 1999, 首创环保集团 is a state-owned environmental protection flagship listed company under Beijing SASAC. By end of 2025, the company operates in 29 provinces and over 190 cities, with water treatment capacity of 27.28 million tons/day and annual domestic waste processing capacity of 14.98 million tons. The company's mission is "共建清洁、美丽、繁荣的幸福家园" (building a clean, beautiful, and prosperous happy home), and its vision is to be a trustworthy leader in environmental sustainable development.

**Business Segments**: The company provides comprehensive "水、固、气、能" (water, solid waste, gas, energy) solutions across:
- Water and water environment services (1,900+ plants, water supply capacity 12.61 million tons/day, sewage treatment 14.67 million tons/day, reclaimed water 0.56 million tons/day, sludge 975 tons/day)
- Sanitation, solid waste disposal and environmental remediation (processed 11.12 million tons of domestic waste, provided 2.818 billion kWh clean grid electricity, 867,604 GJ clean heat, 7.53 million m³ clean gas)
- Municipal air pollution control (serving 40+ cities/industrial parks)
- Resource and energy management (70 government/enterprise energy consulting projects, 10 clean heating projects covering ~17.22 million m²)

**Double Materiality Analysis**: The company identified 20 material topics, with 8 classified as high financial materiality. Top topics include environmental management, water resource management, pollutant emissions, innovation-driven development, climate change response, energy utilization, product/service safety and quality, and ecosystem/biodiversity protection.

**Sustainability Governance**: A three-tier governance structure exists (Board of Directors → Strategy & Sustainability Committee → Sustainability Working Group). ESG ratings: 中诚信国际 AA- (2023-2025), 中证 A (2025), 万得 AA (2025), CDP water questionnaire B (2025), 标普 CSA 37 (2025, up from 17 in 2023).

**Climate Change Response**:
- Goals: unit output energy and CO2 emissions to keep declining during "15th Five-Year Plan"; CO2 emissions peak by 2029; renewable energy share ≥88% by 2030; net positive impact on biodiversity and zero net deforestation by 2050.
- 2025 total GHG emissions: 347.97万吨 CO2e (Scope 1: 250.95, Scope 2: 89.60, Scope 3: 7.42万吨), with intensity of 1.84万吨/亿元 revenue.
- GHG reduction of 196.25万吨 CO2e (up 35.38% from 2024), achieving reduction intensity of 0.18 tCO2e/ton waste.
- Invested RMB 1.45亿元 in climate response and low-carbon transition.
- Installed photovoltaic systems in 12 water projects (18.60 MW, generating 17.22 million kWh in 2025); issued over 4.39 million green certificates cumulatively (2024-2025), with cash flow recovery over RMB 7 million.
- Identified physical risks (flood, extreme cold, drought, typhoon, sea level rise, global warming) and transition risks (market, policy/legal, technology, reputation), with detailed response strategies.

**Environmental Management**:
- No major environmental law violations or major pollution accidents in 2025.
- Established four-level environmental management responsibility structure and passed ISO 14001 external supervision audit (valid until 2027).
- Pollutant emissions data (2025): NOx 3,811.80 tons, SOx 697.17 tons, HCl 493.92 tons, CO 258.15 tons, particulate matter 108.45 tons.
- Wastewater pollutant reductions: COD 57.95万吨, BOD 26.48万吨, total phosphorus 0.98万吨, total nitrogen 7.26万吨, ammonia nitrogen 7.06万吨.
- Waste: hazardous 8,200.66 tons (production), non-hazardous 2,367,807.12 tons (production).

**Water Management**:
- Total water withdrawal 17.17亿吨 (2025); withdrawal in water-scarce regions 5.28亿吨 across 90 projects.
- Self-use water rate target 3.50%, achieved 3.33%; NRW/leakage target 12.50%, achieved 12.20%, with 9 consecutive years of decline.
- Reclaimed water use 8,393.54万吨.
- No major water resource incidents or serious penalties for water-related regulatory violations in 2025.

**Energy & Resource Efficiency**:
- Total energy consumption 210.94万吨 standard coal, intensity 1.12 tons/万元 revenue.
- Key initiatives: intelligent scheduling, equipment upgrades, "药管家" intelligent chemical dosing (reduced chemical dosage 12.20% in Hohhot), patent-protected nitrogen removal control system in Beijing Dongba (reduced carbon source dosage 14.50%).
- 2025 chemical cost savings of RMB 12 million; tons-water electricity consumption down 0.20%, tons-water chemical cost down 2.50%.
- Incineration diesel consumption 0.31 kg/ton waste, down 35.42% from 2024.

**Technology & Innovation**:
- "Blue Water Factory" concept using proprietary CAPITAL CREATE® aerobic granular sludge technology (with ASMART® control system) reduces operating costs 20% and carbon emissions ~30%. Successfully commercialized at Haining (Zhejiang) plant in 2024, increasing capacity from 40,000 to 70,000 tons/day (75% capacity increase without additional land).
- First national major special project for aerobic granular sludge in Tianjin (Ninghe District).
- 2025 innovation R&D investment: RMB 2.12亿元; 296 researchers; 52 patent applications, 83 patents granted, 1,185 cumulative authorized patents; 19 innovation platforms; led/participated in 6 standard publications (3 national, 1 local, 2 group standards); 9 science/technology awards.
- Breakthrough in trace pollutant detection (PFAS, antibiotics) with CMA certification.
- AI+ Action Plan launched 2025, focusing on "vertical business upgrade" and "management capability reconstruction", with WEAM platform applied in 30+ projects.
- Unmanned cleaning vehicles operational in Ma'anshan (daily 11km cleaning); E-decision environmental decision system in Jiujiang/Huainan (Jiujiang: 699 issue clues identified, permit review efficiency +40%).

**Social Performance**:
- Customer satisfaction: 96.68 points (target >92); 122 sewage project evaluations with 93% rectification rate; 30 water supply project evaluations with 91% rectification rate.
- Safety: RMB 94.13 million safety investment, 128 safety inspections.
- Employees: 67 distressed employees helped, RMB 5.62 million training investment, 46.5万元 relief funds.
- Rural revitalization: total donations/assistance RMB 5.85 million (consumption assistance RMB 2.95 million, donations RMB 2.89 million).
- Supply chain: 100% first-tier suppliers signed integrity and social responsibility commitments; 100% obtained ISO 9001/14001/45001 certifications; 38,787 registered suppliers.

**Business Ethics**: Anti-corruption training for 1,741 people (17 hours); 38 compliance training sessions covering 6,000 people; no corruption litigation cases.

**Awards (2025)**: "水业十大影响力企业" (23 consecutive years), "固废十大影响力企业" (14 consecutive years), Beijing ESG Top 10 cases for state-controlled listed companies, 2025 listed company sustainable development best practice case, 2025 Best Green ABS/ABN Award, Beijing first batch sustainable disclosure pilot enterprise, Beijing intellectual property advantage unit, and only trusted data space pilot unit in Beijing environmental field.

一、报告期内公司所属行业及主营业务情况说明 （一） 公司所属行业情况 中国环保行业在经历多年政策驱动与规模扩张后，2025 年进入一个全新的发展阶段。行业整 体呈现出内在重构的显著特征，政策端更加强调市场化机制与精准监管；市场端逐步进入从大规 模基础设施建设向精细化管理和运营的过渡期；技术创新与智能化、低碳化与资源化正在加速突 破。2025 年5 月中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅联合印发的《关于健全资源环境要素市场化配置 体系的意见》明确提出，到2027 年要基本完善碳排放权、用水权交易制度，建立健全排污权交易 制度。 这一顶层设计标志着资源环境要素配置方式的历史性转变。 在政策执行层面， 2025 年6 月， 生态环境部发布《产品碳足迹管理体系建设进展报告（2025） 》 ，加快完善碳足迹管理体系，推动 碳排放统计核算标准和技术规范的统一，为市场化碳交易奠定基础。这种政策导向的转变，反映 出环保治理思路已从“强制减排”向“引导激励”转变， 通过市场机制激发企业自主减排的内生动力。 1.政策支持与资金保障。2023-2024 年间中央财政累计下达生态环保专项资金超1,800 亿元， 2025 年上半年环保专项资金继续向污水处理、固废处理和新能源设施建设等重点领域倾斜。政策 支持方式从“大水漫灌”转向“精准滴灌”，更加强调绩效导向和市场化运作，这种“专项行动+资金 配套”的地方实践，将有效提升政策执行效率。 2.标准体系与执法规范持续完善。2025 年7 月生态环境部审议通过《城镇污水处理厂污染物 排放标准》修改单等4 项生态环境标准，对水污染物排放管理提出更精准的要求。同时， 《生态环 境违法案件挂牌督办管理办法》正式实施，明确8 类重大环境违法案件将被挂牌督办，彰显出执 法趋严的态势。这种“标准引领+严格执法”的政策组合，既为环保技术创新提供了明确方向，也为 行业创造了公平竞争环境。 3.碳市场扩容提升收益预期。全国碳市场在上半年实现八大高排放行业（电力、建材、钢铁、 有色、石化、化工、造纸、航空）全面覆盖，环境权益质押融资规模同比大幅增长。碳排放权、 排污权等环境权益正逐步成为环保企业的重要资产，推动行业价值重估。天津、重庆等地试点碳 资产质押融资业务，允许企业将碳排放配额作为担保物，有效盘活了碳资产并拓展了环保企业融 资渠道。 这种市场化政策的推进， 将推动垃圾焚烧发电行业在碳市场扩容和技术创新双重驱动下， 呈现结构性变革。 4.重点领域监管持续加压。中央生态环境保护督察组在上半年全面启动第三轮第四批督察， 显示出对重点行业污染治理的持续高压态势，推动环保治理从末端处理向全过程控制转变。 北京首创生态环保集团股份有限公司2025 年半年度报告 9/218 综合来看， 2025 年上半年环保政策端最显著的特征是“市场化导向”与“精准化监管”双轮驱动。 （二） 公司主营业务情况 公司致力于成为美丽中国的建设者和守护者，面对气候变化带来的挑战，公司积极探索碳减 高价值的企业品牌信誉 首创环保集团前身是首创股份，于2000 年4 月上市，2021 年更名为首创环保集团。自成立以 来，在北京市国资委、首创集团的带领下，经营业绩在行业内名列前茅，具有较好的发展基础和 发展潜力。 经过多年深耕，公司业务遍布全国170 个地级市，备受各地客户认可，拥有水务、固废、大 气综合治理700 多个项目。公司城镇水务业务经过20 多年的稳扎稳打，目前已形成全国性的业务 布局，公司水处理能力达到2,735.26 万吨/日，位居国内环保行业前列；固废业务的发展也触及大 部分省市，尤其是江西、 河南等地，现已形成比较优势，固废处理能力达到1,498 万吨/年。在ESG 方面，公司连续两年上榜国务院国资委“国有企业社会责任·先锋100 指数”，入选“国资国企社会责 任蓝皮书”（2024 版） ，多次获评“北京市属国有控股上市公司ESG 十佳案例”等相关奖项，并入选 2024 服贸会“ESG 综合治理标杆企业”。在董事会建设方面，公司董事会实践连续两年入选中国上 市公司协会“上市公司最佳董事会实践案例”。 在行业影响力层面， 公司连续22 年荣获“水业十大影 响力企业”称号，连续13 年荣获“固废十大影响力企业”称号，还荣获“首都文明单位”称号。 2.
稳定高效的市场拓展能力 公司已初步构建“水、固、气、能”多业态全产业链业务布局，具备为客户解决综合环境治理需求 的能力。 公司还将继续丰富业务类型和价值链条， 未来可根据客户需求， 为客户提供高价值多元服务。 公司依托全国性项目布局和多元化业务模式，形成了覆盖广泛、高效协同的市场网络体系。公司 业务区域布局广泛，通过搭建业务中台，设立区域公司、城市公司等更贴近市场和客户需求的区域组 织架构，提升本地化服务能力，充分发挥项目属地优势，增强客户粘性，提高存量市场占有率，持续 挖掘城市市场网络的巨大价值。 目前， 已构建遍布全国大部分潜力省市的28 个城市公司和2 个区域公 司的市场网络。 3.

产业转型升级风险 当前，产业驱动要素从工业化和城镇化转变为“双碳目标”引领下的产业转型。传统水务、垃圾处理市场趋于饱和，工程类业务毛利率持续压缩。 客户需求从工程驱动向以系统解决方案为核心的服务加快升级，未来行业竞争重心从“跑马圈地”转向“存量资产效率提升”。由于客户对专业服务能力需 求的持续提升，以技术和运营为核心的精细化能力成为决定竞争成败的关键要素。 应对措施：面对“十四五”收官与“十五五”启航的历史交汇点，环保行业虽经历深度调整，但国家双碳目标下的绿色转型浪潮仍将释放长期增长动能。 当前挑战本质是行业从“规模扩张”转向“价值创造”的必经阵痛期，公司正紧密围绕国家生态文明建设导向，谋划战略转型突破口：一是紧抓政策红利， 依托“两新两重”增量政策，夯实资产业务基础，并围绕碳市场扩容、工业技改加速等机遇，将政策势能转化为业务增量。二是筑牢技术护城河，聚焦高 效、绿色、智慧的目标，以低碳技术重构价值链、以AI 赋能运营降本、找准资源化技术锚点，推动服务产品化升级，破解“重资产依赖”。三是打开新增 长空间，大力重构公司业务组合，加大“进退守试”调整力度，并围绕资源能源新赛道，以“二次创业”的革新勇气和“长期主义”的战略定力，重塑企业核 心竞争力，提升高质量发展动能。 2.

# 首创环保：卓越运营筑高质量增长之基，科技创新谋可持续发展之路

时间：2023-04-25 14:13

来源：首创环保

**“生态+”战略全面深化**

**卓越运营夯实业绩基础**

截至2022年底，首创环保总资产1,048.83亿元;归属于上市公司股东的净资产273.22亿元;实现营业收入221.57亿元，其中轻资产类业务收入占比进一步提升;实现归属于上市公司股东的净利润31.54亿元，同比增长34.68%，毛利率水平提升1.64个百分点。剔除新西兰处置及京通路影响后，经营活动现金流量净额为25.36亿元，同比增长2.59亿元，增幅11.56%。公司本期拟分红规模9.54亿元，同比增幅达30%。

**业绩结构持续优化，卓越运营优势彰显**

2022年年报显示，公司核心运营业务优势凸显，成为公司业绩的重要支撑。

城镇水务

2022年，公司城镇水务板块聚焦运营，积极推动项目收入增长，有效控制成本，实现项目质量的持续提升，同时增量项目不断投运，经营业绩加速释放，城镇水务运营业务实现营业收入103.9亿元，同比增加14.77亿元，增幅16.57%。2022年，公司实现16个项目水价调增，涉及处理水量124.19万吨/日。公司以污水产能利用率、供水产销差率、吨水电耗药耗等关键生产指标为抓手，推动运营效率的不断优化，生产管理能力的持续提升。

固废业务

2022年，公司固废处理板块实现营业收入68.97亿元。得益于焚烧项目逐步进入运营阶段以及系列提质增效工作，固废处理板块核心的焚烧运营业务实现营业收入16.23亿元，同比增长85.27%。报告期内，深州焚烧、都昌焚烧、玉田焚烧、遂川焚烧、杞县焚烧及杞县生物质共6个项目均获得商业运营批复。

大气业务

2022年，大气综合治理业务新增市政水、固废处理等板块的环境治理类设备销售业务，实现营业收入8.21亿元，同比增加2.3亿元，增幅39.16%，实现营业利润1.18亿元，同比增加2,625万元，增幅28.67%。

水环境综合治理业务

2022年，公司积极推动水环境综合治理项目转运营，实现运营收入5.84亿元，同比增加2.52亿元，增幅75.71%。

城市深耕初见成效，新兴业务实现突破

“深耕城市”是首创环保集团“生态+2025”战略的核心之一。公司聚焦重点城市，深挖客户需求。2022年度，公司新签约订单134亿元，其中，轻资产业务占比超60%，通过城市公司新签订单额35.20亿元，占全年新签订单总额的26.14%。此外，公司在城乡供水一体化业务、工业水处理业务、矿山修复、环卫业务、环保装备业务等领域均实现新突破。

**金融资管持续深化，产业结构优化明显**

2022年度，公司在资金募集、财务性投资、资产管理三方面收获颇丰。

首创水务REIT累计实施现金分红3次，分红总金额超3亿元;底层资产持续高质量运营，公司投资的中科环保在深圳证券交易所创业板成功上市、碧兴科技IPO在上海证券交易所已获首发通过。

海外业务方面，公司完成新西兰项目处置，形成良好的投资回报，大幅改善公司现金流，资产负债结构持续优化。

**ESG建设和披露亮点凸显，ESG评级提升**

2022年，公司提供清洁能源上网电量18.5亿千瓦时，代替 53.65万吨标准煤，减少104.90万吨二氧化碳当量，同比增长125.65%。公司ESG评级显著提升，取得行业领先地位，其中，在富时罗素(FTSERussell)评级由1.6提升至2.5;万得(Wind)评级由BB级提升至A级。

**“攻坚，提质，增量，创新”推动高质量发展**

2023年是检验集团化重组融合成果的关键一年。公司总经理李伏京表示，2023年公司将以“质提量增”为工作总基调，聚焦“攻坚、提质、增量、创新”四个核心，统筹推进各项经营工作。

攻坚

针对存量资产，公司将继续聚焦主航道，围绕资产质量、地域区划、资产结构开展资产调优工作，根据公司“进、退、守、试”业务战略，按照“一企一策”策略，逐项落实各项资产盘活、资产退出行动计划。

提质

城镇水务板块，公司将重点围绕提升产能利用率、调价、延长特许经营期、降低吨水可变成本、降低产销差率实现高质量发展目标;在固废业务方面，加大投转建、投转运、建转运的转化速度，提升吨垃圾上网电量，深化技改增效，探索新的盈利增长点;大气业务方面，强化高附加值衍生业务拓展，加快装备技术产品植入，推动已中标工业服务业务的履约闭环等一系列重点工作，实现ROE等高质量发展指标的全面优化。

增量

公司将锚定城市深耕策略，一方面，持续做好1,112万吨/日自来水供应、1,454万吨/日污水处理、21,470吨/日垃圾焚烧三项主要业务存量产能释放;持续推动111.05万吨/日自来水供应、92万吨/日污水处理及5,400吨/日垃圾焚烧发电三项业务在建产能加快“建转运”，形成优势业务规模增量。另一方面，充分利用公司业务体量优势，纵向拓展上下游产业及服务业务、技术产品，不断扩展公司业务范围;横向探索各业态的协同，推动协同订单落地。同时，打造以技术创新和技术沉淀为基础的产品体系，将存量项目作为支点，融入公司在环博会上发布的 16 个技术产品，实现公司立体化的价值创造。

创新

金融创新方面，继续推动REITs扩募，形成“开发→培育→盘活→再开发”的投融资良性循环;组织创新方面，持续推进面向客户的“解决方案型组织”建设，按照一个组织、一个目标、一致行动的总体要求，全面深化前台、中台、后台的组织设计与融合，形成更能满足客户需求、更敏捷的组织力量。持续推动科技创新，为公司的发展提供长期的发展动能。

**首次解读“十四五”科技创新总体思路**

**开启未来可持续发展之路**

形势需求

随着“十四五”环保市场从投资驱动向能力驱动转变，行业政策的不断推动引发了新兴技术的需求，科技创新成为推动行业发展的重要支撑。当前，环境系统性问题、点状技术难题仍未有效破解，呼唤系统性研发与治理;传统资源能源消耗型治理模式亟需向资源能源循环利用模式转变;在大体量资产管理运维中，提升生产、管理信息化与自动化的水平从而提升效率显得意义重大;如何与跨业态成熟技术融合革新，赋能智能制造，提升产品价值成为痛点、难点。基于此，公司明确科技创新总体方向将以“系统化”“资源化”“数字化”和“集约化”方向展开。

规划目标及创新路径

公司提出以下几大科技创新总体目标：力争在十四五期间的研发强度达到2%;科创人员占比达到3%;技改增利金额达到1亿元、发明专利达到120个、技术产品孵化新业务营收实现显著增加。同时，公司勾勒出水务领域90项、固废领域28项、大气服务与治理领域30项、能源服务业务3项的技术图谱，制定了“70%科创型技改”“20%技术创新”“10%前沿技术研究”的721科技创新路线。

产品体系

未来，首创环保集团将以“突出专业价值、聚焦客户需求、强化技术驱动”为原则构建技术产品体系，着力打造以创新技术为核心，以解决方案和智能制造为支撑的三大体系，覆盖可持续水资源管理、可持续智慧城市、创新低碳技术、可持续固废资源管理四大应用场景，形成矩阵式产品系列。

支撑体系

为了更好地支撑十四五科技创新目标的落地，公司将打造以协同创新研究院战略引领，事业部群创新策源，研发基地承接落地，外部机构战略补充的科技创新主体体系;建立基于客户和市场需求的IPD的产品开发导向的科研管理体系;建立科技创新人员管理体系，加快人才聚集和培养。通过以上三大支撑体系，有效推动科技创新对新业务的孵化，将技术打造为竞争力、源动力、硬实力，以科技创新赢得主动、赢得优势、赢得未来。

This is a news article from China Solid Waste Network (中国固废网) published on April 25, 2023, about Capital Environment Holdings (首创环保/首创环保集团), a major Chinese environmental services company. The article outlines the company's 2022 annual performance and its strategic plans for 2023 and beyond under its "Ecology+" (生态+) strategy.

**2022 Financial Highlights:**
- Total assets: 104.883 billion yuan; net assets attributable to shareholders: 27.322 billion yuan
- Revenue: 22.157 billion yuan (with lightweight asset business revenue share increasing)
- Net profit attributable to shareholders: 3.154 billion yuan, up 34.68% year-on-year; gross margin improved 1.64 percentage points
- Operating cash flow (excluding New Zealand disposal and Jingtong Road impact): 2.536 billion yuan, up 11.56%
- Planned dividends: 954 million yuan, up 30% year-on-year

**Business Segment Performance (2022):**
- Urban water services: operating revenue of 10.39 billion yuan, up 16.57%; 16 projects received water price increases covering 1.2419 million tons/day of treated water
- Solid waste: operating revenue of 6.897 billion yuan; core incineration operations revenue of 1.623 billion yuan, up 85.27%; 6 projects (Shenzhou, Duchang, Yutian, Suichuan, Qixian incineration, and Qixian biomass) received commercial operation approval
- Atmospheric business: revenue of 821 million yuan, up 39.16%; operating profit of 118 million yuan, up 28.67%
- Water environment comprehensive treatment: operating revenue of 584 million yuan, up 75.71%

**Other 2022 Achievements:**
- New contracts signed: 13.4 billion yuan, with lightweight assets exceeding 60%; city company contracts totaled 3.52 billion yuan (26.14% of total)
- Capital Wuye REIT completed 3 cash distributions totaling over 300 million yuan
- ESG rating improved: FTSE Russell upgraded from 1.6 to 2.5; Wind upgraded from BB to A
- Provided 1.85 billion kWh of clean energy to grid, replacing 536,500 tons of standard coal and reducing 1.049 million tons of CO2 equivalent (up 125.65%)

**2023 Strategy - "Attack, Improve Quality, Increase Volume, Innovate" (攻坚、提质、增量、创新):**
- Asset optimization with "one enterprise, one policy" approach for asset revitalization and exits
- Focus on capacity utilization, price adjustments, extended concession periods, reducing variable costs per ton
- Continue expanding production capacity: 11.12 million tons/day water supply, 14.54 million tons/day sewage treatment, and 21,470 tons/day waste incineration as existing capacity; 1.1105 million tons/day water supply, 920,000 tons/day sewage, and 5,400 tons/day incineration in construction
- Innovation: continue REITs expansion, build "solution-oriented organization" structure, promote 16 technology products released at environmental expo

**"14th Five-Year Plan" Science & Technology Innovation Strategy:**
- Targets: R&D intensity of 2%, S&T personnel share of 3%, technical retrofit profit of 100 million yuan, 120 invention patents
- Technology roadmap: 90 items in water, 28 in solid waste, 30 in atmospheric services/governance, 3 in energy services
- "721" innovation route: 70% technology retrofit, 20% technology innovation, 10% frontier research
- Building a three-system product framework (core innovation technology, solution-based, smart manufacturing) covering sustainable water resource management, sustainable smart cities, innovative low-carbon technology, and sustainable solid waste resource management
- Three supporting systems: collaborative innovation research institute, IPD product development research management, and S&T personnel management

The article also includes related news about Capital Environment, including a 460 million yuan investment in a Jiangxi waste-to-energy expansion project, plans to issue up to 2 billion yuan in corporate bonds, and a BOT project win for three sewage plants in a county-level "one zone, three parks" project at 6.39 yuan/ton.

You are tasked with summarizing the raw content of a webpage retrieved from a web search. Your goal is to create a summary that preserves the most important information from the original web page. This summary will be used by a downstream research agent, so it's crucial to maintain the key details without losing essential information.

Here is the raw content of the webpage:

<webpage_content>
【世界水日】粤海水务：“变而通，变而兴”，老牌国企的深耕与开拓

## 【世界水日】粤海水务：“变而通，变而兴”，老牌国企的深耕与开拓

粤海控股集团    [广东国资](javascript:void(0);) 

**广东国资** ![]()

报道广东国资系统发展动态，宣传广东国资系统改革成就，助力广东国资系统改革发展，传播广东国资系统正能量。

粤海水务是我国最早投身水务事业的国有企业之一，由粤海水务运营管理的东深供水工程，实现了50多年不间断为香港安全优质供水。经过几十年的发展，粤海水务的产业链不断发展延伸，业务范围涵盖了原水供应、自来水经营、污水处理和水环境综合治理等。

目前粤海水务在全国各地投资运营水务项目40余个，服务约5800万人口。水处理规模逐年稳步提升，E20研究院数据显示，**粤海水务2017年以2507万吨/日的水务总规模，跃居全国第二**。

**业界领先的水安全管理水平**

粤海水务负责运营的东深供水工程承担着香港70%至80%、深圳50%以上、东莞沿线8个镇80%左右的原水供应，供水规模达864万吨/日，为香港的繁荣稳定和深圳、东莞的经济腾飞作出了重要贡献。同时，对港50多年不间断的安全优质供水，使粤海水务逐步形成了“水安全专家”的强大品牌基因。

秉承"生命水、政治水、经济水"的核心经营理念，粤海水务始终把安全放在第一位，坚持“安全为本”的指导思想，将安全作为文化融入到企业管理之中。

2013年公司通过国家级水利工程管理考核，开创了水利行业泵站和水库工程同时高分通过验收的先河，成为国家级水利工程管理单位；2015年在全国水利行业首批取得水利部安全生产标准化一级达标证书，成为国内水务行业安全管理的品牌引领者。

**深耕细作、开拓市场新领域**

近几年，粤海水务在坚持做好广东、香港地区原水供应、自来水运营以及污水处理等水务业务的基础上，触角逐步扩展到内陆地区。

引调水工程建设运营是粤海水务引以为豪的传统优势业务。目前由粤海水务主导投资建设的珠江三角洲水资源配置工程，是广东省历史上投资额最大、输水线路最长、受水区域最广的水资源调配工程，也是粤港澳大湾区可持续发展的重大战略工程；粤海水务近几年也通过市场竞争，先后获得国家财政部首批30个PPP 示范项目之一的江苏徐州骆马湖原水供应项目、国家财政部第三批PPP示范项目之一的江苏盐城新水源地及引水工程项目。2018年，粤海水务将引调水工程建设及运营这一传统优势项目成功延伸至华中地区，签约湖北省恩施州车坝河水库引水工程PPP项目，项目估算总投资10.40亿元，引水工程总长度约23.10千米。

以下为2018年粤海水务中标的部分具有代表性的项目列表：

**构建生态圈，形成产业链、区域一体化**

新时代背景下，水务企业不仅需要创新以及资本的助力，更要实现积极的生态化转型。粤海水务副总李文锋认为，未来企业发展首先应注重市场，使行业结构由竞争转向合作，相互依存，构建生态圈。

“水十条”的发布，不仅让传统的市政供排水领域焕发生机，更激发出水环境综合治理等新兴领域的市场机遇。2018年，粤海水务接连与中建三局二公司及中建五局、中建三局、葛洲坝第六工程公司、中冶华天签署战略合作协议，共同开发水体综合治理、供水排污工程及相关配套管网设施领域的PPP项目等合作。

同时粤海水务聚焦重点城市，分别与潮州市政府和铜川市政府签署战略合作协议，在供排水、污水处理、水环境项目等领域寻求深入合作。粤海水务开放平台，优势互补，为形成产业链和区域一体化的战略布局不断添砖加瓦。

**精于科研，以技术促发展**

近年来环保行业开始重新讨论技术回归，而早在20年前水务行业刚刚开始市场化改革的时候，粤海水务就已经开始注重科技研发。

一直以来，粤海水务同水处理技术领域专家、科研所保持全方位的交流合作，先后与清华大学、同济大学、哈尔滨工业大学等水处理领先的院校与科研机构建立了战略合作关系。同时，建成国家级博士后科研工作站、广东省饮用水安全保障工程中心及广东省企业科技特派员工作站等多个科研平台，以及国内一流的水环境监测中心。2018年，粤海水务与中国工程院王浩院士合作共建院士工作站，融合专家与企业优势，进一步强化科研力量。

公司强大的技术团队准确地把握了风云变幻的市场趋势，以市场需求为导向，陆续完成了多项国家、省、市级研发课题，在原水水质预警及水质净化、饮用水深度处理、管网漏损检测与控制、小型污水处理和智慧水务等方向形成了一系列的核心技术。其中“饮用水深度处理技术”获省科技进步奖，“城镇管网漏损检测与控制技术”成果破解城市供水管网漏水难题，成效显著。

**创新引领，打造智慧水务品牌**

早在2012年，粤海水务便专注于智慧水务建设，在国内率先提出智慧水务发展理念。智慧水务是保障用水安全的重要尖端信息技术，近年已经成为传统水务企业升级或业务拓展的重要方向。

2017年，粤海水务组建成立智慧水务平台公司，推进智慧生产、智慧运营、智慧服务、智慧管理等水务综合一体化进程。应用物联网、云计算、大数据等高新信息技术，团队自主研发智慧水务产品，实现水务管理的全面升级。目前已开发出多套具有自主知识产权的软件产品，形成客服系统等软件著作权7项，通过示范推广，使粤海水务的智慧水务建设走在行业前列。

粤海水务不仅在智慧管网领域形成自身的核心技术，还涉足智慧生产、智慧服务和智慧管控等多个领域，开发出营业收费、生产监控、水务运营分析等20余项核心产品，且产品和方案均处于行业领先地位。

“变则通，不变则壅；变则兴，不变则衰；变则生，不变则亡”。粤海水务副总李文锋说。2019年新年前夕，备受关注的由粤海水务牵头投资建设的珠江三角洲水资源配置工程初步设计报告获水利部批复，该工程将于2019年上半年全面开工建设，粤海水务又将踏上新征程。

This article, published for World Water Day by Guangdong State-owned Assets (via Guangdong Holdings Group), profiles Guangdong Yuehai Water (粤海水务), one of China's earliest state-owned water utility enterprises. 

**Company Overview & Scale:**
- Yuehai Water operates over 40 water investment projects across China, serving approximately 58 million people
- In 2017, with a total water treatment scale of 25.07 million tons/day, it ranked SECOND nationally (per E20 Research Institute data)
- Its business spans raw water supply, tap water operations, sewage treatment, and comprehensive water environment governance

**Dongjiang-Shenzhen Water Supply Project (东深供水工程):**
- Yuehai Water manages this project, which has provided uninterrupted, safe, high-quality water to Hong Kong for over 50 years
- Supplies 70-80% of Hong Kong's raw water, 50%+ of Shenzhen's, and ~80% for 8 towns along Dongguan
- Supply scale reaches 8.64 million tons/day
- This track record built Yuehai Water's strong "water safety expert" brand

**Safety Management Achievements:**
- Core operating philosophy: "Life Water, Political Water, Economic Water" (生命水、政治水、经济水), with safety as the top priority
- 2013: Passed national-level water project management assessment, becoming a national-level water project management unit (first in the industry for simultaneously passing both pump station and reservoir evaluations)
- 2015: Among the first batch in the national water industry to receive the Ministry of Water Resources' Level 1 Safety Production Standardization certificate

**Market Expansion (2018 highlights):**
- Pearl River Delta Water Resources Allocation Project: the largest investment, longest water transmission line, and widest water receiving area in Guangdong's history; a major strategic project for the Greater Bay Area
- Won Jiangsu Xuzhou Luoma Lake raw water supply project (one of the Ministry of Finance's first 30 PPP demonstration projects)
- Won Jiangsu Yancheng new water source and water diversion project (Ministry of Finance's third batch PPP demonstration project)
- Signed Hubei Enshi Chebahe Reservoir water diversion PPP project (total estimated investment of 1.04 billion yuan, ~23.10 km water diversion length), extending into Central China

**Ecosystem & Partnership Strategy:**
- In 2018, signed strategic cooperation agreements with China Construction Third Engineering Bureau 2nd Company, China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau, China Construction Third Engineering Bureau, Gezhouba Sixth Engineering Company, and MCC Huatian for comprehensive water governance, water supply/sewage projects, and related pipeline network PPP projects
- Signed strategic agreements with Chaozhou and Tongchuan city governments for water supply, sewage treatment, and water environment projects

**R&D and Technology:**
- Strategic partnerships with Tsinghua University, Tongji University, Harbin Institute of Technology, and other leading water treatment institutions
- Established national-level post-doctoral research workstation, Guangdong Province Drinking Water Safety Guarantee Engineering Center, and a first-class water environment monitoring center
- 2018: Established an academician workstation with Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Wang Hao
- Developed core technologies in raw water quality early warning/purification, drinking water deep treatment, pipeline network leakage detection/control, small-scale sewage treatment, and smart water services
- "Drinking water deep treatment technology" won Provincial Science and Technology Progress Award
- "Urban pipeline network leakage detection and control technology" effectively solved urban water supply pipeline leakage problems

**Smart Water (智慧水务):**
- Pioneered smart water development concept in China as early as 2012
- 2017: Established a smart water platform company advancing smart production, operation, service, and management
- Applied IoT, cloud computing, big data technologies; developed multiple proprietary software products with 7 software copyrights
- Developed 20+ core products including billing, production monitoring, and water operations analysis, all industry-leading

**Future Outlook:**
- Vice General Manager Li Wenfeng's philosophy: "Change brings access; change brings prosperity; change brings life" (变则通，变则兴，变则生)
- The Pearl River Delta Water Resources Allocation Project's preliminary design report received Ministry of Water Resources approval in late 2018/early 2019, with full construction expected to begin in the first half of 2019

## 创新驱动，粤海水务多维度助推绿色节约发展

发表时间：2022-11-18分享到：

复制链接成功

11月15日，第二十四届中国国际高新技术成果交易会（以下简称高交会）于广东省深圳市隆重开幕。作为其中的重磅单元活动，以“发展节水产业，建设节水型社会”为主题的首届全国节水高新技术成果展备受各界关注。

　　作为首届全国节水高新技术成果展的主办单位之一，广东粤海水务股份有限公司（以下简称粤海水务）坚持以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，坚定践行新发展理念，认真贯彻“节水优先、空间均衡、系统治理、两手发力”的治水思路，以推动建设节水型社会为己任，将节水创新的理念贯穿于“源头到龙头”的业务全领域与生产全过程。

**强作为**

**高质量建管大型水资源配置工程**

　　2021年10月，广东省水利高质量发展大会正式提出，构建覆盖全省16个地级以上城市、惠泽逾7600万人民的“五纵五横”广东水网主骨架，全力解决水资源时空分布不均衡问题，有效应对极端干旱等风险情况。

　　作为广东省属粤海控股集团（以下简称粤海控股集团）旗下集原水供应、自来水经营、污水处理、水环境综合治理、清洁能源和科技研发等多种业务于一体的全产业链大型水务运营商，粤海水务坚定践行国企担当，凭借卓越的工程“建设运营一体化”能力，在“五纵五横”水网主骨架中，担起了珠江三角洲水资源配置工程、环北部湾广东水资源配置工程、东深供水工程和韩江榕江练江水系连通后续优化工程“四横”的建管重任，按照“节水优先、空间均衡”的总体思路，进行科学、高效、均衡、长远的水资源配置规划。

珠江三角洲水资源配置工程施工现场

　　在粤港澳大湾区核心腹地，国家级水利工程珠江三角洲水资源配置工程正火热建设。该工程能有效解决珠三角东部区域供水水源单一的问题，为香港、广州番禺、佛山顺德等地提供应急备用水源。目前，工程全线48条盾构隧洞均已贯通，转入内衬施工阶段，向2023年底通水目标全力冲刺。

环北部湾广东水资源配置工程施工现场

　　在北部湾畔，国务院2022年重点推进的55项重大水利工程之一——环北部湾广东水资源配置工程也在加速推进。该工程将本地水资源和供水工程无法覆盖区域作为重点受水区，统筹考虑节水改造、中水回用、用水发展等既有资源与发展需求，确保建成后实现江库联调、水源互济、供需平衡，系统解决粤西地区缺水问题，大幅提高区域水安全保障能力。

　　在粤东地区，旨在解决区域资源型缺水问题的韩江榕江练江水系连通后续优化工程建设正酣。该工程旨在优化粤东地区水资源配置格局，提升区域水安全保障能力，解决广大粤东群众“吃水难”问题，为经济社会发展提供有力供水支撑。

　　从东莞到深圳，输水线路全长68公里的东深供水工程，在粤海水务的高质量运营管理下，延续着半个多世纪从未间断地向香港、深圳和东莞三地安全优质供水的光荣使命。近年来，粤海水务积极推动东深供水工程节能技术改造，采取循环利用生产用水、加强输水通道生物侵蚀防治等有效措施，在节水节能降耗方面取得了扎实成效。

**多举措**

**供排水全链条探索应用节水新技术**

　　作为水务行业龙头企业，粤海水务当前在全国各地投资运营各类水务项目超过110个，水处理规模超过5600万吨每日，服务人口逾9400万。在与民生息息相关的城乡自来水供应和污水处理项目运营中，粤海水务在安全优质服务的前提下，积极应用各类节水技术手段，将绿色发展理念融入日常运营管理。

智能管网漏损管理系统

　　粤海水务始终将供水管网控漏作为运营管理的重中之重，多措并举降低管网漏损率，减少水资源浪费、降低能耗。日常运营中，粤海水务严格把控管道材料与安装管理，研究开发了一系列控漏应用系统。粤海水务牵头的“城市供水管网漏损检测与控制技术”科研项目，提出建立管网三层级分区技术体系，采用管网动态压力调控、基于贝叶斯与盲源分离算法的漏失评价定位等技术，形成集管网GIS、管网分区、管网监控、管网建模及压力管理系统于一体的智慧管网漏损控制数字化平台。该项目成果已广泛应用于粤海水务下属企业以及黑龙江、山西等地20多家自来水公司，每年节约水资源超4700万吨，节省生产成本2300余万元，获广东省科技进步奖二等奖。其中，东莞常平水司管网漏损率从20.77%降至目前的10%以下，供水电耗降低21.07%，每年持续产生700多万元效益，实现了较高的经济与社会效益。

粤海水务自主研发的小型农村一体化供水设备

　　在农村优质饮用水及非常规水资源开发方面，粤海水务开发农村供水一体化设备、苦咸水优质饮用水处理设备等，并在广东信宜、茂名，新疆喀什等地进行应用，满足了用户“有水喝、喝好水”的需求。粤海水务自主研发的小型农村一体化供水设备，可灵活选择“模块运输、现场组装”和“整体运输”方式，可同时进行砂滤或膜处理，实现最优出水水质。相比于传统滤池，该设备能耗可降低60%，反冲洗周期最高可延长6倍，真正实现低耗高效、节水节能。目前，该设备已应用于广东省云浮、茂名等地26个镇、400多个自然村，为近50万乡村百姓安全优质供水，积极助力农村集中供水全覆盖攻坚行动和美丽乡村建设。此外，粤海水务正在开发高效能、低成本、长寿命的新型涉水膜材料，研制装配式水处理设备，有望打破新型高性能膜材料技术壁垒，实现进口产品国产化替代，助力绿色低碳水系统建设。

“好氧颗粒污泥+MBR”组合短流程工艺中试设备

　　在再生水开发利用领域，粤海水务依托江苏无锡三家再生水厂，实施了高标准再生水回用示范工程，通过“超滤+反渗透”工艺，合计处理规模达22.57万吨每日，生产的再生水已供给电子半导体、光伏、制药等19家工业企业。此外，粤海水务精研“好氧颗粒污泥+MBR”组合短流程工艺，积极降低膜污染，提高出水水质，出水可达河道补源、生态补水、园林景观灌溉和工业生产用水等回用标准，实现了污水资源化再生的技术新突破。

**重创新**

**倾力打造“智慧水务”产业新高地**

　　作为国内“智慧水务”的先行者，粤海水务2020年与科技头

　　部企业携手打造国内首家“鲲鹏智慧水务联合创新实验室”，共同推进前沿技术研发升级。当前，粤海水务坚持创新驱动、科技赋能，大力推动大数据、人工智能、数字孪生等新一代信息技术与节水技术、管理及产品的深度融合。

南沙水司数字孪生水厂

　　在广州南沙，粤海水务将下辖3座水厂打造成为供水规模合计58万吨、服务人口88万的“智慧水务标杆示范水厂”，通过SCADA、云边协同、大数据分析、AI视频识别等技术，搭建水厂智能化投药、消毒、调度、监盘、巡检、检修等智慧应用，实现水厂“无人值班、少人值守”。下一步，将通过建设基于5G的厂网一体化调度系统，结合管网水力模型、需水量预测及机组优化控制策略等，科学调度出厂水压，优化管网运行压力，进一步降低管网漏损率，实现更高的节水管理目标。

迳头污水处理厂

　　在开平迳头污水处理厂，粤海水务采用智能识别、自动控制等科技手段，搭建具备运营监控、水质管理、安全信息管理等功能的“智慧水务”运营系统，实现“分散控制、集中管理”“精细标准、少人值守”的高水平智能管控。同时，积极探索节水减排新工艺，开展小型智能化污泥好氧发酵科研合作等项目，实现污水厂污泥过程减量及资源化利用。在首届“双百跨越”污水处理标杆比选活动中，该厂获得2021—2022年度“智慧管控标杆污水厂”和“污泥资源利用标杆污水厂”两项荣誉。

汕头中心城区提压改造项目智能泵房

　　在粤东汕头市，粤海水务承建的中心城区供水系统提压改造项目于今年10月中旬完工。该项目是当地2021年、2022年“十大民生实事”，采取水厂提压技改、市政干管修复、社区管网改造等措施，解决中心城区110万百姓用水水压不足的问题，赢得政府肯定、百姓好评。项目建设中，粤海水务通过建设智能泵站泵房，对片区供水进行变频加压，并实现24小时远程管理；搭建加压站及二供泵房监控系统，及时发现停水、水压不足等异常情况，避免设施“跑冒滴漏”风险。

　　展望未来，粤海水务党委副书记、总经理李海飞表示，粤海水务将深入贯彻党的二十大精神，坚定践行国企担当与社会责任，以主办首届全国节水高新技术成果展为契机，进一步高质量推进水务工程建设运营，高水平打造“智慧水务”产业新高地，立足粤港澳大湾区、辐射全国，全面倡导落实节水创新理念，为助推绿色发展和美丽中国建设贡献力量。
